programme.title: The Hit List
programme.desc: Marvin and Rochelle Humes present a celebrity edition of the music-based quiz show, featuring Arielle Free, Paul Young, Fiona and Eilish O'Carroll, Gary Davies and Richie Anderson. The three teams must name as many hit songs and artists as possible under intense pressure, with a £10,000 jackpot for charity up for grabs.

programme.title: The Farmer's Llamas
programme.desc: When the Farmer and Bitzer go to a country fair, Shaun the Sheep steals away with them intent on causing mischief. He spies an auction where he sees three exotic and very crafty llamas going under the hammer. Instantly impressed by their amusing pranks, Shaun sneakily gets the Farmer to buy them, but it's not long before these cheeky newcomers wreak havoc. Animated fun, with the voice of Justin Fletcher.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Shaun escapes through a portal inside Shirley's wool to flee an annoying Bitzer, only to emerge into a chaotic version of the farm without him. Desperate to escape, he repeatedly jumps back inside Shirley, emerging somewhere worse each time.

programme.title: The Gruffalo
programme.desc: Animated adaptation of Julia Donaldson's best-selling children's book. It tells the tale of a little mouse who takes a walk through the woods in search of a nut, only to encounter a fox, an owl and a snake who all want to eat him. To escape their clutches, the quick-witted rodent creates an imaginary monster to scare away his attackers - but it turns out to be all too real. Robbie Coltrane heads the voice cast as the Gruffalo, with James Corden as the Mouse and Rob Brydon, John Hurt and Tom Wilkinson as the predators.

programme.title: The Gruffalo's Child
programme.desc: Animated adaptation of the sequel to Julia Donaldson's best-selling children's book, reuniting all the voice cast from the original. The Gruffalo has raised his daughter on tales of the big, bad mouse, the only creature in the forest he is frightened of. Despite her father's warnings, she sets off in search of this scary creature, along the way encountering the snake, owl and the fox. But when she still has no luck finding the evil rodent, she begins to think he does not exist after all. Robbie Coltrane, James Corden and Rob Brydon lend their voices, with Shirley Henderson as Gruffalo Jr.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: Inventor Wallace and his canine sidekick Gromit have set up a pest-control service, and are called in to stop rabbits overrunning a garden show. However, the pair are overwhelmed when a destructive giant bunny arrives on the scene, while an interfering aristocrat contrives to make matters worse. Nick Park's Oscar-winning animated adventure, with the voices of Peter Sallis, Ralph Fiennes and Helena Bonham Carter.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: A mischievous rabbit has the run of a farm and its vegetable patch when the owner unexpectedly dies. When a relative inherits the property, he strives to rid his land of the rabbit and his woodland friends - but his feelings for a nature-loving woman complicate the battle of wits with the animal kingdom. Family comedy based on Beatrix Potter's stories, starring Domhnall Gleeson and Rose Byrne, with the voices of James Corden and Margot Robbie.

programme.title: Minions: The Rise of Gru
programme.desc: Young Gru attends an interview to join a diabolical dream team christened the Vicious 6, but Belle Bottom, Jean-Clawed, Nun-chuck, Svengeance and Stronghold cruelly dismiss the boy. In retaliation for the ageist snub, the resourceful tyke steals an ancient amulet that can harness the power of the 12 creatures of the Chinese zodiac. Animated comedy prequel, featuring the voices of Steve Carell, Alan Arkin, Taraji P Henson and Jean-Claude Van Damme.

programme.title: Puss In Boots: The Last Wish
programme.desc: The swashbuckling cat joins forces with sexy pickpocket Kitty Softpaws and lovable stray dog Perrito to journey deep into the Dark Forest. They attempt to locate the fabled Wishing Star, which can restore his spent lives. Animated comedy, with the voices of Antonio Banderas and Salma Hayek.

programme.title: Paddington 2
programme.desc: The lovable little bear has settled into his new life with the Brown family in London, becoming a much-loved member of the local community - until his search for a birthday present for his aunt leads to him being framed as a thief. While the Browns try to clear Paddington's name, he tries to make himself at home in prison, winning over the other convicts and getting involved in an escape attempt. Comedy adventure, starring Hugh Bonneville, Hugh Grant and Sally Hawkins, with Ben Whishaw providing the voice of Paddington.

programme.title: Would I Lie to You
programme.desc: Rob Brydon hosts a festive edition of the comedy panel show. Regular team captains David Mitchell and Lee Mack are joined by Jools Holland, Swarzy Shire, Helen George and David Walliams as they try to hoodwink their opponents with absurd facts and plausible lies about themselves.(New).

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: The craft experts spread a little Christmas joy, visited by special guests including Helen Mirren, who brings along a dilapidated cello belonging to a care home for people who have worked in the entertainment industry. Also popping in are children's author Julia Donaldson and Rob Brydon, who are seeking a repair to a toy farmhouse given to Julia by her granny. The experts also repair a life-size mechanical Rudolph belonging to Leicestershire Fire Service, a broken 80-year-old sledge for a Northern Ireland family and a tattered carol book that has played a central role as part of a local tradition in Sheffield.(New).

programme.title: Call the Midwife
programme.desc: Conclusion of the two-part story. In Hong Kong, Sister Julienne and Sister Hilda face down Denzil, who demands the keys to the Order's new property. Trixie and Geoffrey walk Mr Fischer home and learn he has a terminal blood disorder, so they hastily arrange for a rabbi to visit for the first night of Chanukah, the Jewish feast of lights. Rosalind and Joyce host a Christmas gathering at Nonnatus House with their friends and medical colleagues, while Sister Catherine decides to find out what happened to Queenie's baby.(New).

programme.title: EastEnders
programme.desc: Police officers swarm the Square as Walford reacts to the fallout of an explosive December 25. With shocking secrets exposed, and more questions than answers, those in the midst of the drama struggle to see a way forward. Meanwhile, the Mitchells enjoy a family dinner, and Nigel puts preparations in place to make this Christmas an extra special one.

programme.title: Four Weddings and a Funeral
programme.desc: A London man's misfortunes in love look set to change when he meets an American beauty. However, the prospect of a transatlantic relationship succeeding seems slim, so the pair go their separate ways - only for him to realise he is unable to get her out of his mind. Richard Curtis's comedy, with Hugh Grant, Andie MacDowell, John Hannah, Charlotte Coleman, Kristin Scott Thomas, Simon Callow and James Fleet.

programme.title: Michael McIntyre's The Wheel
programme.desc: A festive edition of the game show, which sees Richard Osman, Mel Giedroyc and Paddy McGuinness competing to win a big cash prize for their chosen charity. Helping them along the way are fellow celebrities Gyles Brandreth, Josie Gibson, Big Narstie, Tim Vine, Zara McDermott, Harry Aikines-Aryeetey and Gavin and Stacey themselves, Joanna Page and Mathew Horne.

programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt is joined by chefs Hasan Semay and Julie Lin, and by special guest Sue Perkins. Helen McGinn pairs drinks with the studio dishes, and Elliott Grover make party canapes.

programme.title: The Great Food Guys
programme.desc: Nick Nairn and Dougie Vipond return to their Aberdeenshire country kitchen for the second of two festive specials, making a hearty venison pie with seasonal vegetables. Joining them is international wrestler and TV actor Graeme Stevely - better known as Grado - to chat, taste and raise a glass.

programme.title: Football Focus
programme.desc: Alex Scott looks ahead to the weekend's matches, including Everton v Arsenal and Tottenham Hotspur v Liverpool. Plus, news from Newcastle United v Chelsea in the lunchtime game.

programme.title: Despicable Me 2
programme.desc: A reformed criminal mastermind who has abandoned his wicked ways for a life of fatherhood and jam-making helps a secret agent to bring one of his fellow evil geniuses to justice. The villain in question has stolen a dangerous experimental serum with the power to turn harmless animals into ravening monsters. Animated comedy sequel, with the voices of Steve Carell and Kristen Wiig.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
programme.desc: Viking warrior Hiccup and his faithful dragon Toothless venture out into a hidden world to protect their village from the darkest threat yet. However, Toothless is distracted by a white female Fury dragon, held captive by warlords, and soon falls in love. Third chapter in the animated fantasy saga, featuring the voices of Jay Baruchel, America Ferrera and Cate Blanchett.

programme.title: Alan Carr's Picture Slam
programme.desc: Alan Carr hosts this game show in which three teams of contestants have to identify a board full of images, with a chance of winning up to £10,000 if they know them all. Hoping to take home the jackpot this week are friends Ann and Steven from Paisley, couple Khamisha and Jack from London, and best friends Ella and Alex from Brighton.

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job
programme.desc: In the sun-kissed hills of Andalusia, Amanda Holden and Alan Carr continue their work on renovating a run-down townhouse, while also savouring the festive traditions of the region. The pair dance and sing at a Christmas lights switch-on in Malaga, enjoy the local culture and celebrate with residents. However, the duo discover they have very different ideas when it comes to Christmas decorations.

programme.title: Biggest Night of Musicals by the National Lottery
programme.desc: Jason Manford presents highlights of the past four years' concerts celebrating West End musicals and touring productions, featuring performances from Mary Poppins, The Bodyguard, Matilda the Musical, The Phantom of the Opera and Back to the Future: The Musical. Jason and Beverley Knight get things started with a circus-themed number from The Greatest Showman, Michael Ball performs with Our Dementia Choir and a there's a presentation of Electricity from Billy Elliot by two grass-roots groups. Plus, an all-star performance of Bring Him Home from Les Misérables, featuring four Jean Valjeans, and Wicked favourite Defying Gravity, by Laura Pick.(New).

programme.title: Elvis
programme.desc: On his deathbed, enigmatic music manager Colonel Tom Parker recalls his relationship with the King of Rock 'n' Roll, whose rise to fame he orchestrated. Over the course of a tumultuous period in American history, the singer takes the world by storm while also struggling against Parker's controlling influence. Baz Luhrmann's biopic of the singer, starring Austin Butler, Tom Hanks and Olivia DeJonge.

The eight initially have to work together to try to win up to £50,000 for their individual chosen charity, with one player voted The Weakest Link by their fellow contestants at the end of each round. Eventually, the last two go head to head for whatever cash they have managed to amass.

programme.title: Chicken Run
programme.desc: A headstrong chicken and her fellow fowls ponder how to escape from a grim Yorkshire farm before the evil farmer's wife can turn them into pies. Luckily, help arrives in the form of a heroic American rooster who promises to show them how to fly. Nick Park's animated comedy, with the voices of Mel Gibson, Julia Sawalha, Miranda Richardson and Jane Horrocks.

programme.title: Dexter Procter: The 10-Year-Old Doctor
programme.desc: The first of two specials based on Adam Kay's children's books. Child prodigy Dexter has become a paediatrician at the age of 10, and spends his days trying to solve frequently disgusting medical mysteries, find his place in the world, and deal with a jealous adult colleague determined to see him sacked. Starring Cian Eagle-Service, Peter Serafinowicz, Harry Enfield and Jameela Jamil.

programme.title: Penguins: Meet the Family
programme.desc: Documentary following penguins living in unexpected environments, including satellite imagery of previously undiscovered colonies of flightless birds. Among their habitats are dense forests, desert burrows and city streets. The programme reveals the challenges they face in making their homes in these challenging environments, from evading predators to scaling rocks, and captures the lifelong bonds formed between family groups.

programme.title: Tennis: Battle of the Sexes
programme.desc: Nick Kyrgios v Aryna Sabalenka. Coverage of the exhibition match, held at Coca-Cola Arena in Dubai. The contest sees 2022 Wimbledon finalist Kyrgios take on the current women's world number one over the best of three sets, with each player receiving just one serve per point.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Hamza Yassin heads to the Cromarty Lighthouse Field Station at the edge of the Moray Firth, where scientists are tracking Scotland's resident bottlenose dolphins in the UK's longest-running study of its kind. As our seas face change, the findings are helping to build a picture of the wider health of our marine ecosystems. Plus, a look back through the archives, shining a light on conservation projects around the UK.(New).

programme.title: Celebrity Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Linford Christie, Britain's most decorated sprinter, goes in search of a slower way of life, with the help of his daughter Briannah and presenter Alistair Appleton. Together they tour a range of homes in the rolling hills of the Chilterns, take a trip along the Thames at one of the world's most elegant country homes and cook up a storm with an exclusive outdoor dining experience, fully immersing themselves in the Buckinghamshire and Oxfordshire countryside.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents a showcase of unseen treasures from Trentham Gardens in Staffordshire, including a rare Shamshir sword and a painting by George Leslie Hunter. Plus, Fiona's antiques knowledge is put to the test with three pieces of pottery with Cubist designs, and ceramics expert and long-standing Roadshow regular John Sandon chats about his life in antiques.(New).

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: The office Christmas party of a lifetime takes a dark turn when four co-workers wake up to find a stranger dead in the pool of their villa. DI Mervin Wilson and the team identify the murder weapon, but are left baffled when they find it was locked in a drawer when the murder took place - thousands of miles away from the crime scene. Meanwhile, Mervin anxiously waits to hear back from his newly discovered brother, which prevents him from getting into the festive spirit and embracing Saint Marie's Christmas celebrations. Festive instalment of the detective drama, starring Don Gilet, with guest appearances from Josie Lawrence, Kate Ashfield, Pearl Mackie and James Baxter.(New).

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, featuring Sunderland v Leeds United at Stadium of Light and Crystal Palace v Tottenham Hotspur at Selhurst Park. The Black Cats and Leeds were both promoted from the Championship last term and it was Sunderland who adapted to top-flight football the quickest. Palace will have hoped for another three points after defeating their London rivals Spurs home and away last term.

programme.title: Stuffed
programme.desc: After Arslan Farooqi receives an unexpected £8,000 Christmas bonus at work, he and his family set off on the trip of a lifetime when they swap Coventry for the magic of Lapland. However, chaos ensues it turns out the bonus was a mistake and must be repaid immediately. Disaster subsequently follows the family at every turn. Together with new holiday friend Lily, they seek a way out of this predicament and hope for a festive miracle that can save Arslan's job and their livelihood. One-off comedy, starring Guz Khan, Morgana Robinson, Theo Barklem-Biggs and Sue Johnston.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: The Elizabethan dramatist suffers from writer's block while working on his new play, and to make matters worse creditors are about to close down the theatre. But when a noblewoman disguises herself as a man to fulfil her dream of appearing on stage, the Bard becomes enchanted by her and is inspired to pen the most famous love story of all time. Comedy, with Joseph Fiennes, Gwyneth Paltrow, Judi Dench, Ben Affleck, Geoffrey Rush, Martin Clunes and Tom Wilkinson.

programme.title: Room on the Broom
programme.desc: Animated adaptation of the children's book by author Julia Donaldson and illustrator Axel Scheffler, the creators of modern classic The Gruffalo. It tells the story of a kind witch who invites a surprising number of animals to ride on her broom - much to the frustration of her cat. But when a fearsome dragon appears, what will the gang do? Gillian Anderson heads the voice cast as the witch, with Rob Brydon, Martin Clunes, Sally Hawkins and David Walliams as the animals, Timothy Spall as the dragon and Simon Pegg as narrator.

programme.title: The Famous Five
programme.desc: When a Spitfire crashes near Kirrin Cottage, the intrepid teenagers must work together to save the injured pilot and find out the truth of what happened to him - before his enemies strike again. Children's adventure, starring Diaana Babnicova and Elliott Rose.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Dion Dublin is joined by Toyah Willcox in a 20th anniversary celebrity special, to look around a three-bedroom semi in her native Birmingham. Jacqui Joseph is in Lincolnshire to see a ground-floor flat. Plus, a look through the series archives to remember one of Dion's early appearances, where he shows off his dance moves at a former nightclub in Burnley.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Roo Irvine presents a special edition about tiny antiques and collectibles, leading through some of the smallest books in the world at the University of Glasgow and meeting a photographer who makes miniature replicas of the city's best-known cafes and pubs.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit 2: The Runaway
programme.desc: Thomas and Bea are now married and living with Peter and his rabbit family. Bored of life in the garden, Peter goes to the big city, where he meets shady characters and ends up creating chaos for the whole family. Adventure sequel, starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson, with the voices of James Corden and Margot Robbie.

programme.title: Back to the Future
programme.desc: Teenager Marty McFly travels back to the 1950s in a time machine built by his eccentric inventor friend. The return journey proves tricky enough, but he also accidentally alters the sequence of events that led to his parents falling in love - and has to persuade his future dad to win his mother's heart, or he will never be born. Sci-fi comedy adventure, starring Michael J Fox, Christopher Lloyd, Lea Thompson and Crispin Glover.

programme.title: Celebrity Bridge of Lies
programme.sub-title: Celebrity Bridge of Lies: EastEnders Special
programme.desc: Ross Kemp starts a new series of the celebrity quiz with an episode featuring his fellow EastEnders stars, to celebrate the 40th anniversary of the soap. Adam Woodyatt, Michelle Collins, Micah Balfour and Molly Rainford must face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing, depending on the question category.

programme.title: Pointless Celebrities
programme.desc: Alexander Armstrong and Richard Osman present a sports special which sees Ugo Monye, Sarah Hunter, Beth Tweddle, Vanessa Bauer, Will Bayley, Anita Asante, Ellie Robinson and Jack Laugher trying to come up with the answers that no one else could think of.

programme.title: Celebrity Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Television and radio presenter Angellica Bell and her husband, former fellow children's TV favourite Michael Underwood, team up with Nicki Chapman to find a family home in the Devon countryside. The property savvy pair show they're still happy to roll up their sleeves and get mucky, as they take on a DIY miniature dream home build, and there are even talks of full-scale renovations at a 1930s period proposal.(New).

programme.title: EastEnders
programme.desc: The Beales and Brannings prepare to celebrate Jimmy's christening, and one Walford family attempts to navigate a way forward following Christmas.(New).

programme.title: MasterChef
programme.sub-title: MasterChef Festive Extravaganza: Champion of Champions
programme.desc: A quartet of previous winners - Natalie Coleman, Thomas Frake, Chariya Khattiyot and Brin Pirathapan - re-enter the kitchen to compete in a festive culinary showdown. At stake is the golden pan trophy and their reputation. All they need to do is serve up a show-stopping dish fit for royalty, then present two of the best courses they have ever cooked, demonstrating how far they have progressed since they first entered the competition as amateurs. To help them decide the winner, judges Grace Dent and John Torode will be joined by restaurant critic Tom Parker Bowles.(New).

programme.title: The Apprentice
programme.desc: Part one of two. AJ Odudu, Angela Scanlon, Charlie Hedges, Eddie Kadi, Jake Wood, JB Gill, Kadeena Cox, Matt Morsia, Rob Rinder, Sarah Hadland, Shazia Mirza and Tom Skinner compete to raise money for Children in Need. Lord Sugar splits the celebrities into two teams, under the watchful eyes of Karren Brady and Mike Soutar, and sends them to Lapland to create their own twist on the classic gingerbread biscuit before producing an advert and jingle, and pitching to retailers. For the first time in Celebrity Apprentice history, the products will be on sale to the public to raise money for Children in Need.(New).

Anne is in despair at being separated from her family and Felicity is increasingly irritated by her sister's high spirits, while Mal finds a hidden photo that appears to reveal a deep family secret. Jennifer Saunders guest stars in a festive episode of the Motherland spin-off, starring Lucy Punch, Joanna Lumley and Philippa Dunne.

programme.title: Tabby McTat
programme.desc: Animated adaptation of the Julia Donaldson book. Tabby McTat the singing cat and his busker friend Fred entertain the crowds of London, but become separated when Fred breaks his leg while pursuing a thief. Lost and alone, Tabby is taken in by a friendly fellow cat and finds a whole new life for herself with a kindly family - leaving him torn between two very different homes. Narrated by Jodie Whittaker, with the voices of Rob Brydon and Sopé Dirísu.

programme.title: The Croods 2: A New Age
programme.desc: Still searching for a place to settle down, prehistoric patriarch Grug leads his family to the great unknown. Hoping for the best in an increasingly dangerous world, while trying to come to terms with Eep and Guy's budding romance, Grug stumbles upon a secluded Eden of plenty, containing everything that they have been seeking. However, there is a catch. This area is already occupied by the significantly more evolved Bettermans - Phil, Hope and their daughter Dawn. Animated comedy sequel, with the voices of Nicolas Cage, Emma Stone and Ryan Reynolds.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Martin Roberts is joined by celebrated interior designer Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen to look around a three-bedroom terrace just outside Bristol. Needless to say, Laurence falls in love with its avocado bathroom suite. There's also a trawl through the show's archives of 2005, when Martin saw a disused former public toilet that was up for sale at auction. Jacqui Joseph is in Essex to see a three bed semi that's crumbling from the outside and letting the street down.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Natasha Raskin Sharp introduces a special edition celebrating antiques and collectables from around the world. From fabulous French glass and sparking Scandinavian jewellery to amazing antiques from Asia and Africa, this episode delves into the archive to remember some of the most memorable buys from around the globe. At the National Museum of Scotland in Edinburgh, Natasha gets a tour of a gallery bursting with European furniture, including a few trend-setting examples which wouldn't look out of place in the modern home.

There's a new take on the theme tune and some familiar figures and faces from the challenges and round tables. Oscar-winning Rodgers and Hammerstein musical, starring Julie Andrews, Christopher Plummer and Eleanor Parker.(n)

programme.title: Wild London
programme.desc: Having lived in London for 75 years, David Attenborough shares his intimate knowledge of the city's natural history. London is considered the greenest city in the world with a surprising variety of animal dramas playing out in the most unexpected places - whether it's pigeons commuting by the Tube, snakes slithering along Regent's canal, parakeets raiding city parks or beavers building a home next to a busy shopping centre. The veteran naturalist celebrates the extraordinary ways animals adapt to survive in the urban jungle and the inspiring initiatives to encourage nature back into the city.(New).(n)

Suspicions, secrets and lies echo around the castle, as under the cover of darkness, the Traitors must pick off the residual players one by one, eliminating them from the game. The faithful must try to work out who the traitors are in their midst, banishing them from the game before becoming their next victim. Those who make it to the final have a chance of winning the life-changing cash prize.(New).(n)

programme.desc: Tom Hiddleston reprises his role as soldier-turned-hotel night manager Jonathan Pine in the long-awaited return of the acclaimed drama. The story picks up after nine years with Jonathan living as Alex Goodwin, a low-level MI6 officer running a quiet surveillance unit in London. His life is comfortingly uneventful until the chance sighting of former mercenary connected with arms dealer Richard Roper prompts a call to action and leads him to a violent encounter with a new player - Colombian businessman Teddy Dos Santos. Once in Colombia, Pine is plunged deep into a deadly plot to destabilise the country. With Olivia Colman, Diego Calva and Douglas Hodge.(New).(n)

Starring Phil Davis, Brendan O'Carroll, Simon Delaney, Paddy Houlihan and Deirdre O'Kane.(New).(n)

Fred and Violet fly out to Hong Kong to visit Derek - only to notice a large building has collapsed. Back in London, news of the disaster reaches Nonnatus house and an emergency rescue mission to Kowloon is hastily launched. But Derek warns the medics to take care, as the densely populated city is home to Triad gangs operating in the area.

There's also a performance by boy band Blue, the professionals show the amateurs how it's done with a couple of yuletide routines and judges Shirley Ballas, Craig Revel Horwood, Motsi Mabuse and Anton Du Beke give their thoughts on the dances.

The pair are joined by local star Dawn French, their favourite doctor Anand Patel and visit chef Paul Ainsworth in his Padstow restaurant to prepare a Christmas feast of turbot.

They must put their own twist on a pattern for a Santa present sack, turn second-hand party wear into outfits based on The Twelve Days of Christmas and create clothing for models inspired by their favourite seasonal treat. Judges Esme Young and Patrick Grant keep a close eye on every stitch and hem and decide which famous face deserves the festive title.

On his first wander from Little Haven to Solva, he tries surfing, learns about a UFO sighting that stunned the world and helps a local artist create a mural. On his second creative close encounter, Derek discovers the place that captivated and inspired poet Dylan Thomas, as he takes a walk through the town of Laugharne on the Carmarthenshire coast. For his final flashback, Derek is back in Pembrokeshire, peek ing at seal pups, learning how to train a sheepdog and creating a unique giant sand circle.

As she starts to fall for the bemused academic, she decides to stop him marrying his severe assistant, and accidentally endangers his efforts to get funding for his beloved museum. Drama, starring Steve McQueen, James Coburn, Donald Pleasence, James Garner, Charles Bronson and Richard Attenborough.

programme.desc: Buddy and Conker invite Aiyla to make spicy tomato pasta and learn the basics of karate.

programme.title: Danger Mouse
programme.desc: A double-length musical special. Danger Mouse reluctantly takes part in Pink Dawn's re-enactment of Melted, a famous ice-themed musical phenomenon.

programme.title: Boy Girl Dog Cat Mouse Cheese
programme.desc: The siblings try to prepare an awesome Christmas surprise for their parents, but things go wrong every step of the way.

programme.title: Deadly Predators
programme.desc: Steve looks back at his top Deadly Predators from the series and meets the ultimate predator. He reviews the biggest and best stunts from the series and reveals how the team bought a giant air vortex cannon to the Deadly junkyard to demonstrate the predatory prowess of the sperm whale.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: Lynn and Sandra in the Highlands get a surprise when they harvest their first batch of honey. The Rodgers family gather to give bull Mario a good send-off, while Raymond and Johnny discover their sheep are under threat from flystrike, and the only way to protect them is to put the entire flock of 1,600 through the sheepdip.

programme.title: Double Indemnity
programme.desc: An insurance salesman has an affair with the wife of a client, who persuades him to help kill her husband for the policy he has arranged. While the plan is successful, one of the salesman's colleagues suspects foul play. Billy Wilder's thriller, starring Barbara Stanwyck, Fred MacMurray and Edward G Robinson. Co-scripted by Raymond Chandler from the novel by James M Cain.

programme.title: Inside the Factory
programme.desc: Paddy McGuinness and Cherry Healey visit the Original Biscuit Bakers factory in Market Drayton, Shropshire, to learn how they produce 100,000 gingerbread biscuits each week. Historian Ruth Goodman joins astronaut Helen Sharman to explore Christmas in space and Bobby Seagull teaches Cherry how to wrap presents using maths.

programme.title: The Seven Year Itch
programme.desc: A bored publisher revels in his new-found freedom after his wife and son go away to the country. When a beautiful but naive actress moves in upstairs, he is tempted to turn his fantasies of an affair with her into reality. But even in his dreams, his conscience has a way of tripping him up. Billy Wilder's comedy, starring Marilyn Monroe, Tom Ewell, Evelyn Keyes and Oscar Homolka.

programme.title: Some Like It Hot
programme.desc: After witnessing a Mob hit in Chicago, two male jazz musicians don drag and hide out with an all-girl band to evade the gangsters pursuing them. However, the pair struggle to disguise their attraction for the beautiful lead singer - while one of them catches the eye of a smitten millionaire. Billy Wilder's classic romantic comedy, starring Jack Lemmon, Tony Curtis and Marilyn Monroe.

programme.title: Final Score
programme.desc: Jason Mohammad presents a round-up of the results and this afternoon's news from the Premier League, EFL and Scotland.

programme.title: Dad's Army
programme.desc: The platoon challenges a rival regiment to a gruelling duel, involving map-reading, initiative tests, river-crossing and field-fighting, to prove they are fitter and better trained than any other troop. Christmas special of the comedy with the bumbling Home Guard of Walmington-on-Sea from 1971, starring Arthur Lowe, John Le Mesurier and Ian Lavender.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: In a festive episode first broadcast in 1995, Hyacinth resorts to alternative methods of recruitment when she gets no response to the adverts for a pageant she is directing. Suburban sitcom, starring Patricia Routledge.

programme.title: Fawlty Towers
programme.desc: Basil's belief that guests are an obstacle to the smooth running of his hotel is borne out by the arrival of an aggressive woman (Joan Sanderson), and the tension between the two leads to a series of increasingly heated arguments. Classic comedy, starring John Cleese, Prunella Scales, Andrew Sachs and Connie Booth.

programme.title: Lives Well Lived
programme.desc: Kirsty Wark looks back at the extraordinary lives of some of the acting greats, celebrated singers and political giants who died in 2025. Reese Witherspoon, Ralph Fiennes, Elizabeth McGovern and Bob Woodward are among those paying tribute to Robert Redford, Diane Keaton and Gene Hackman, while James Galway and Sheila Hancock honour their friend, jazz singer Dame Cleo Laine. Dominic Monaghan remembers both Patricia Routledge's dramatic and comic performances, while John Cusack, Sting and Al Jardine describe how Brian Wilson reinvented pop music in the 1960s.(New).

programme.title: Unforgiven
programme.desc: Two notorious gunslingers come out of retirement to help a young assassin collect the $1,000 bounty on the heads of a pair of cowboys who attacked and mutilated a prostitute in the backwoods town of Big Whiskey. The local sheriff, however, has no intention of letting the pair impinge on his own authority. Oscar-winning Western, directed by and starring Clint Eastwood, with Gene Hackman, Morgan Freeman, Jaimz Woolvett and Richard Harris.

programme.title: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
programme.desc: Two notorious outlaws' routine of bank and train robberies is cut short when a seemingly unstoppable posse is formed to catch them. The pair plan to flee America and start a new life in Bolivia, with the Sundance Kid's schoolmistress lover in tow - but staying ahead of the law is not so easy. Western, starring Paul Newman, Robert Redford and Katharine Ross.

programme.title: Cleo Laine at the BBC
programme.desc: A look back at the singer's finest moments on the BBC, shown to coincide with her 95th birthday. Britain's 'First Lady of Jazz' became a star after joining The John Dankworth Seven in the 1950s, later marrying the bandleader. Internationally renowned for her mastery of the scat singing style, Cleo has now enjoyed over six decades of success and acclaim here and across the world. Featuring renditions of Send in the Clowns and I Love You Porgy, and duets with John Williams, Dudley Moore, Tony Bennett and her late husband Johnny Dankworth.

programme.title: The War Between the Land and the Sea
programme.desc: Barclay stands alone, UNIT is powerless and the oceans rise as the war reaches its climax. While traitors conspire, can Barclay find Salt before it is too late? Doctor Who spin-off about a conflict between the human race and an ancient species of aquatic reptiles. Starring Russell Tovey and Gugu Mbatha-Raw.

programme.title: Call the Midwife
programme.desc: Conclusion of the two-part story. In Hong Kong, Sister Julienne and Sister Hilda face down Denzil, who demands the keys to the Order's new property. Trixie and Geoffrey walk Mr Fischer home and learn he has a terminal blood disorder, so they hastily arrange for a rabbi to visit for the first night of Chanukah, the Jewish feast of lights. Rosalind and Joyce host a Christmas gathering at Nonnatus House with their friends and medical colleagues, while Sister Catherine decides to find out what happened to Queenie's baby.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: The craft experts spread a little Christmas joy, visited by special guests including Helen Mirren, who brings along a dilapidated cello belonging to a care home for people who have worked in the entertainment industry. Also popping in are children's author Julia Donaldson and Rob Brydon, who are seeking a repair to a toy farmhouse given to Julia by her granny. The experts also repair a life-size mechanical Rudolph belonging to Leicestershire Fire Service, a broken 80-year-old sledge for a Northern Ireland family and a tattered carol book that has played a central role as part of a local tradition in Sheffield.

programme.title: This Is BBC Two
programme.desc: Preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Mathew Baynton, Mel Giedroyc, Harriet Kemsley and Charles Venn test their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games for a special festive show.

programme.title: Prayer and Reflection
programme.desc: A traditional Presbyterian Christmas service from St Giles' Cathedral, Edinburgh, with a combination of scripture, readings and a sermon led by the Rev Dr Scott Rennie. The congregation join in a selection of hymns and carols performed by St Giles' Choir with musical director Jack Oades.

programme.title: Lives Well Lived
programme.desc: Kirsty Wark looks back at the extraordinary lives of some of the acting greats, celebrated singers and political giants who died in 2025. Reese Witherspoon, Ralph Fiennes, Elizabeth McGovern and Bob Woodward are among those paying tribute to Robert Redford, Diane Keaton and Gene Hackman, while James Galway and Sheila Hancock honour their friend, jazz singer Dame Cleo Laine. Dominic Monaghan remembers both Patricia Routledge's dramatic and comic performances, while John Cusack, Sting and Al Jardine describe how Brian Wilson reinvented pop music in the 1960s.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Matt Baker, Anita Rani and Adam Henson uncover the magic of Cadgwith on the Cornish coast at Christmas. From tree deliveries to seasonal pasty-making and a pub full of sea shanties, they see how the community comes together at this special time of year - all building to the big switch-on that floods the cove with festive lights.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek Brockway heads for the hills and a seasonal tour of the best pathways in Wales. In this episode, he goes for a windy walk through the country's only geopark and heads deep into the woods to follow the footsteps of a warrior and wizard.(New).

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie Vipond takes a winter walk in Glen Affric in the Highlands for a special festive edition looking back at highlights from the programme in 2024, revisiting stories that Anne Lundon, Arlene Stuart, Cammy Wilson, Rosie Morton and Shahbaz Majeed have covered. Dougie reflects on the big themes, the best places and the inspiring people the team have met while travelling thousands of miles across the Scottish countryside. Plus, the winner of the BBC Scotland Local Food Hero Award is revealed at the BBC Food and Farming Awards.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt presents party food ideas from Yotam Ottolenghi, Crystelle Pereira and Poppy O'Toole. while actress Emilia Fox faces either her food heaven or hell.(New).

programme.title: Remarkable Places to Eat
programme.desc: Michel Roux Jr takes Fred Sirieix for a Christmas treat in his favourite British city, Bristol. First up is a French bistro where they enjoy a stunning cote de boeuf and Michel makes aligot, known as the best mashed potato in the world. The duo then enjoy a swim in one of Britain's oldest lidos, which has an award-winning restaurant serving up a delicious breakfast. Escaping to the countryside, they visit a hotel and restaurant where Fred makes buffalo mozzarella, while Michel samples the hotel's own cider, before a return to the city and the multicultural neighbourhood of St Paul's, where they learn to cook Caribbean jerk turkey.

programme.title: Snow Wolf Family and Me
programme.desc: Part one of two. Wildlife cameraman Gordon Buchanan hopes to get closer to wild wolves than anyone before to discover the true nature of this feared predator and heads to the north of Canada in search of a pack that has never seen people and so has no fear of humans. He begins to gain the trust of an Arctic wolf family and as time passes becomes accepted by the pack, including a female and its three newborn pups, and has some close encounters that reveal a softer side to the animals.

programme.title: Casablanca
programme.desc: The American expat owner of a Moroccan nightclub is reunited with his old flame during the Second World War. Now married to a Czech freedom fighter, she needs his help to get them safely out of the country before they are captured by the Nazis - but the former lovers also have to wrestle the temptation to rekindle their simmering romance. Drama, with Humphrey Bogart, Ingrid Bergman, Claude Rains and Paul Henreid.

programme.title: Murder on the Orient Express
programme.desc: An American businessman travelling on the Orient Express from Istanbul to Paris tries to hire Hercule Poirot to discover the source of the death threats that have been made against him. The sleuth refuses, but wakes up the following morning to learn the man has been stabbed to death while the train was held up by heavy snow - and there is no shortage of suspects among the passengers. Agatha Christie mystery, starring Albert Finney, Lauren Bacall, Ingrid Bergman, Sean Connery and Vanessa Redgrave.

programme.title: Dad's Army
programme.desc: Pompous Captain Mainwaring proves he is a softie at heart by organising a turkey dinner as a Christmas treat for the struggling senior citizens of Walmington-on-Sea. Festive episode from 1974, starring Arthur Lowe, John Le Mesurier and John Laurie.

programme.title: Victoria Wood: The Secret List
programme.desc: With a career spanning more than 40 years and crossing every possible genre, Victoria Wood amassed a back catalogue bulging with sublime comedy moments. This second of two programmes draws on further favourite sketches chosen by her in a notebook discovered after her death. Plus, contributors discuss her broad catalogue of award-winning comedy.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Mathew Baynton, Mel Giedroyc, Harriet Kemsley and Charles Venn face their final challenges before the overall winner is announced.(New).

programme.title: Celebrity Mastermind
programme.desc: Clive Myrie invites Montell Douglas, Matt Edmondson, Sonnaz Nooranvary and Lewis Goodall to answer questions on the music of Lauryn Hill, the history of board games, the Robert Langdon novels of Dan Brown and US president John Adams. The second round sees them tackling general knowledge questions in a bid to carry off the commemorative trophy.(New).

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell presents a literature-themed edition of the quiz, with the Orwellians and the Jillies facing fiendish, bookish questions. One set of clues asks what the connection is between Brown symbol, Conan Doyle world, Bryson continent and Milton paradise.

programme.title: Christmas University Challenge
programme.sub-title: Exeter College, Oxford v Trinity Hall, Cambridge
programme.desc: The heats of this year's Christmas competition continue, with teams representing Exeter College, Oxford and Trinity Hall, Cambridge competing for a place in the semi-finals. Amol Rajan asks the questions.(New).

programme.title: Titanic Sinks Tonight
programme.desc: From the crucial seconds before the collision to the final moments when the hull sank beneath the waves, this dramatised documentary pieces together events minute by minute to reveal what happened to the 2,208 passengers and crew of RMS Titanic on the night of April 14. 1912. This opening instalment begins with lookout crew member Fred Fleet spotting a black mass right ahead of Titanic and alerting the navigation crew, but the ship still hits the iceberg and news of the damage filters through to the captain.(New).

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: The patriarch of the Corleone crime family is hospitalised after an attempt on his life and entrusts control of his business to his three sons - the violent and unpredictable Sonny, the weak-willed Fredo, and Michael, the youngest brother, who reluctantly takes up the reins but proves to be the most ruthless of them all. Francis Ford Coppola's gangster drama, starring Marlon Brando, Al Pacino, James Caan, John Cazale, Talia Shire, Robert Duvall and Diane Keaton.

programme.title: QI
programme.desc: Sandi Toksvig hosts a festive edition on the theme of winter wonderland, with Julian Clary, Fatiha El-Ghorri and Jimmy Carr joining regular panellist Alan Davies.

programme.title: The Wicker Man
programme.desc: A devoutly Christian Scottish police officer travels to a remote island to investigate the disappearance of a missing girl. As his investigations are disrupted at every turn, the detective is horrified to see the population have embraced an ancient pagan lifestyle, and begins to fear they may intend to sacrifice the child in an occult ritual. Horror, starring Edward Woodward, Christopher Lee and Britt Ekland.

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: The doting matriarch rediscovers the meaning of family as she gathers those closest to her together for a Christmas photo. Buster unveils another of his signature Christmas trees with maximum impact and Cathy frets about what presents to buy everyone. First of two festive specials, starring Brendan O'Carroll, Jennifer Gibney and Danny O'Carroll.

programme.title: Michael McIntyre's The Wheel
programme.desc: A festive edition of the game show, which sees Richard Osman, Mel Giedroyc and Paddy McGuinness competing to win a big cash prize for their chosen charity. Helping them along the way are fellow celebrities Gyles Brandreth, Josie Gibson, Big Narstie, Tim Vine, Zara McDermott, Harry Aikines-Aryeetey and Gavin and Stacey themselves, Joanna Page and Mathew Horne.

programme.title: This Is BBC Two
programme.desc: Preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: Secrets of the Conclave
programme.desc: A rare glimpse at the ancient and secret rituals inside the papal conclave, where cardinals serve not only as electors but as potential successors to the papacy. The documentary features footage from the Vatican and interviews with cardinals who helped choose the new Pope, providing an insight into a tradition that has shaped the leadership of the Catholic Church for centuries, charting the journey of the conclave from mourning to the moment white smoke signals the election of Pope Leo XIV.

programme.title: Gladiators
programme.desc: Bradley and Barney Walsh present a special edition of the contest, in which four famous faces take on tests of speed, strength and skill. The nation's favourite PE teacher Joe Wicks competes against TV and radio presenter Sam Thompson, while boxing favourite Nicola Adams takes on podcaster Vogue Williams.

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, featuring Sunderland v Leeds United at Stadium of Light and Crystal Palace v Tottenham Hotspur at Selhurst Park. The Black Cats and Leeds were both promoted from the Championship last term and it was Sunderland who adapted to top-flight football the quickest. Palace will have hoped for another three points after defeating their London rivals Spurs home and away last term.

programme.title: The Cockleshell Heroes
programme.desc: Fact-based Second World War drama in which eight British Marines carry out a daring operation to canoe into Bordeaux harbour, where they plan to sabotage the German fleet - a mission considered by many to be suicidal. Directed by and starring Jose Ferrer. With Trevor Howard, Dora Bryan and Anthony Newley.

programme.title: The Battle of the River Plate
programme.desc: British naval forces pursue German battleship the Admiral Graf Spee, finally blockading the vessel in Montevideo harbour, where its commanding officer is faced with an impossible choice. Second World War adventure from Powell and Pressburger, starring John Gregson, Anthony Quayle, Peter Finch, Bernard Lee and Jack Gwillim.

programme.title: Snow Wolf Family and Me
programme.desc: Part two of two. Gordon Buchanan returns to Canada in the autumn to reunite with the Arctic wolves he has been following as they try to raise their pups and prepare for winter. The cameraman also walks with members of the pack as they hunt lemmings, musk oxen and hares and encounter a rival pack.

programme.title: North by Northwest
programme.desc: A suave advertising executive is mistaken for an American intelligence agent by a foreign spy and finds himself drawn into a world of espionage and adventure, leading to a high-tension cross-country chase made more perilous when the FBI intervenes. Alfred Hitchcock's thriller, starring Cary Grant, James Mason, Eva Marie Saint, Leo G Carroll and Martin Landau.

programme.title: Death on the Nile
programme.desc: Detective Hercule Poirot investigates a murder on board a paddle steamer in Egypt. The victim was an unpopular heiress, whose outspoken manner put her at odds with most of her fellow passengers during their cruise on the Nile. Agatha Christie mystery, starring Peter Ustinov, Bette Davis, Maggie Smith, George Kennedy, Mia Farrow, Jane Birkin, Olivia Hussey, Angela Lansbury and David Niven.

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob Mortimer, Paul Whitehouse and terrier Ted head to Devon and Cornwall, arriving on a steam train. They fish the rivers Lyd and Camel in Devon and head out to sea in Cornwall on a traditional fishing boat. The pair are joined by local star Dawn French, their favourite doctor Anand Patel and visit chef Paul Ainsworth in his Padstow restaurant to prepare a Christmas feast of turbot.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Alex Brooker, Rhys Darby, Joanna Page and Molly Rainford go toe-to-toe testing their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games across the week.(New).

programme.title: Celebrity Mastermind
programme.desc: Clive Myrie invites Dean Franklin, Chloe Petts, Ashley John-Baptiste and Robyn Cowen to answer questions on the Hangover films, The Vicar of Dibley, American soul singer Donny Hathaway, and the original Karate Kid trilogy. The second round sees them tackling general knowledge questions in a bid to carry off the commemorative trophy.(New).

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts another match in the knockout stage as the Doctors Matthews take on the Worker Bees. The teams must use patience, lateral thinking and sheer inspiration to make connections between four things that may appear at first not to be linked, with one set of clues asking what comes fourth in the sequence 4. Saint Francis, 3. Saint Joseph, 2. Saint James.(New).

programme.title: Christmas University Challenge
programme.sub-title: St Hilda's College, Oxford v Edinburgh
programme.desc: Two more teams made up of distinguished graduates compete to secure a place in the semi-finals, with author Val McDermid captaining St Hilda's College, Oxford against a side from the University of Edinburgh led by architecture writer and critic Catherine Slessor. Amol Rajan asks the questions.(New).

programme.title: Titanic Sinks Tonight
programme.desc: The captain orders the ship to be evacuated and tells the wireless operators to send out an urgent distress call to other ships, while down below in the boiler rooms, the crew pump out the incoming sea water to buy the ship more time. With only enough lifeboats for half the people on board, a rescue mission requires shuttle runs to be made to and from a rescue ship. First-class passengers are handed life-preservers and told to make their way to the boat deck, but they have not been told the ship is sinking.(New).

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: Mafia don Michael Corleone sets out to clinch a make-or-break deal with an ageing gangster - but his plans are blown apart by a traitor within the family. Michael's story is intercut with flashback sequences chronicling the early life of his father Vito as he makes the shift from immigrant grocery-store clerk to Mob kingpin. Francis Ford Coppola's Oscar-winning crime drama sequel, with Al Pacino, Robert De Niro, Robert Duvall, Diane Keaton, Talia Shire, John Cazale and Lee Strasberg.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Matt Baker, Anita Rani and Adam Henson uncover the magic of Cadgwith on the Cornish coast at Christmas. From tree deliveries to seasonal pasty-making and a pub full of sea shanties, they see how the community comes together at this special time of year - all building to the big switch-on that floods the cove with festive lights.

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: The office Christmas party of a lifetime takes a dark turn when four co-workers wake up to find a stranger dead in the pool of their villa. DI Mervin Wilson and the team identify the murder weapon, but are left baffled when they find it was locked in a drawer when the murder took place - thousands of miles away from the crime scene. Meanwhile, Mervin anxiously waits to hear back from his newly discovered brother, which prevents him from getting into the festive spirit and embracing Saint Marie's Christmas celebrations. Festive instalment of the detective drama, starring Don Gilet, with guest appearances from Josie Lawrence, Kate Ashfield, Pearl Mackie and James Baxter.

programme.title: Secrets of the Conclave
programme.desc: A rare glimpse at the ancient and secret rituals inside the papal conclave, where cardinals serve not only as electors but as potential successors to the papacy. The documentary features footage from the Vatican and interviews with cardinals who helped choose the new Pope, providing an insight into a tradition that has shaped the leadership of the Catholic Church for centuries, charting the journey of the conclave from mourning to the moment white smoke signals the election of Pope Leo XIV.

programme.title: This Is BBC Two
programme.desc: Preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: Celebrity Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Television and radio presenter Angellica Bell and her husband, former fellow children's TV favourite Michael Underwood, team up with Nicki Chapman to find a family home in the Devon countryside. The property savvy pair show they're still happy to roll up their sleeves and get mucky, as they take on a DIY miniature dream home build, and there are even talks of full-scale renovations at a 1930s period proposal.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Mathew Baynton, Mel Giedroyc, Harriet Kemsley and Charles Venn face their final challenges before the overall winner is announced.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Alex Brooker, Rhys Darby, Joanna Page and Molly Rainford go toe-to-toe testing their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games across the week.

programme.title: Sir Anthony Hopkins: A Career in Character
programme.desc: In his own words, Sir Anthony Hopkins describes how a deeply troubled boy from Port Talbot, Wales, achieved two-time Oscar glory in Hollywood. He meets Katie Razzall in Los Angeles to tell his story - how he was deemed a failure by his parents, peers and teacher, but went on to triumph in memorable roles like Hannibal Lecter.

programme.title: The Interview
programme.desc: An in-depth interview with Indian-American business executive and current CEO of Google Sundar Pichai, who reveals what it is like to be the head of a multi-trillion dollar company.

programme.title: The Best Dishes Ever
programme.desc: Ainsley Harriott introduces a selection of recipes from the BBC archives for party food, including Lorraine Pascale's white chocolate lollipops, seafood dishes by James Martin and Rachel Khoo's coq-au-vin on a stick.

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
programme.desc: An American couple on holiday in Morocco witness the killing of a local man they have befriended. Before dying he whispers a secret that has serious political implications - but they are prevented from telling the police when their son is kidnapped by a gang of spies bent on keeping them silent. Alfred Hitchcock's remake of his own 1934 thriller, with James Stewart, Doris Day, Bernard Miles and Daniel Gelin.

programme.title: The Third Man
programme.desc: American writer Holly Martins goes to post-Second World War Vienna at the invitation of his old friend Harry Lime, only to be told that Lime has been killed by a car while crossing the street. However, the author finds the circumstances surrounding his death fail to add up and goes in search of the truth - but is unprepared for the ugly secrets he uncovers. Carol Reed's thriller, written by Graham Greene, starring Joseph Cotten, Orson Welles, Alida Valli and Trevor Howard.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Jules Hudson helps a dog groomer who wants to relocate her business to Suffolk on a budget of £320,000. He also meets the team behind an ambitious project to restore an Anglo-Saxon longship, the remains of which were unearthed by an amateur archaeologist in the 1930s.

programme.title: Talking Pictures
programme.desc: A look at the TV appearances made over the years by pioneering film director Alfred Hitchcock, capturing the milestones and highlights of his life and career. Narrated by Sylvia Syms.

programme.title: Dial M for Murder
programme.desc: A former tennis champion suspects his wife is having an affair, so he hatches a plan to have her killed and inherit her fortune. He succeeds in blackmailing a disgraced former soldier into murdering her and making it look like a burglary. However, the plan backfires when the intended victim kills the would-be assassin. Alfred Hitchcock's thriller, starring Ray Milland, Grace Kelly, Robert Cummings and John Williams.

programme.title: Rear Window
programme.desc: A photographer is left housebound and in a wheelchair after breaking his leg in an accident. He passes the time watching the comings and goings of his neighbours in the apartment block opposite and becomes convinced one of them has committed a murder. However, he has trouble persuading anyone to believe his story. Hitchcock thriller, starring James Stewart, Grace Kelly, Raymond Burr, Thelma Ritter and Judith Evelyn.

programme.title: Hercules the Bear - A Love Story
programme.desc: In 1975, wrestler Andy Robin and his wife Maggie adopted nine-month-old bear cub Hercules and, against all the odds, set out to tame one of the world's fiercest animals and what followed was an extraordinary tale of wrestling, rescue and super stardom. Featuring never seen before home video, this documentary revisits the incredible bond between Andy, Maggie and Hercules the bear.(New).

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Alex Brooker, Rhys Darby, Joanna Page and Molly Rainford test their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games for a special festive show.(New).

programme.title: Celebrity Mastermind
programme.desc: Clive Myrie hosts another episode of the classic quiz where four celebrities take to the black chair in aid of their chosen charities. Former athlete Iwan Thomas, Doctor Who actor Sophie Aldred, journalist Mobeen Azhar and broadcaster Ashley James answer questions on the Oscar-winning film Forrest Gump, the actor Sylvester McCoy, Prince's Sign o' the Times album, and the suffragette activist Lady Constance Lytton.(New).

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: In this edition, the law in under the spotlight, with the Cartophiles taking on the Harmonics. Victoria Coren Mitchell presents.(New).

programme.title: Christmas University Challenge
programme.desc: In the final heat, champions from Middlesex face a Lancaster team that reached the semi-finals of Series 3. Amol Rajan asks the questions.(New).

programme.title: Titanic Sinks Tonight
programme.desc: The Titanic goes down fast by the head in the early hours on the morning and there is still over 2,000 people on board the vessel. Without enough lifeboats to go around and no rescue mission in sight, everyone left faces a struggle for survival. As the situation gets more urgent, and in the face of a scramble to get in the remaining lifeboats, guns are handed out to the senior officers to maintain order.(New).

programme.title: Live at the Apollo
programme.desc: Mo Gilligan introduces comedians Laura Smyth and Josh Pugh to the stage, in this show recorded before a packed house at London's Hammersmith Apollo.(New).

programme.title: The Cockfields
programme.desc: Simon and Esther travel to the Isle of Wight at Christmas to visit his doting mother, his controlling yet well-meaning stepfather and his celebrity-obsessed stepbrother. Comedy, starring Joe Wilkinson, Sue Johnston, Susannah Fielding and Gregor Fisher.(New).

programme.title: The Godfather: Part III
programme.desc: Twenty years after ordering the murder of his brother, ageing don Michael Corleone is close to fulfilling his dream of severing his family's Mafia ties and gaining legitimacy, but vengeful enemies and the actions of his hot-headed nephew soon draw him back into a life of crime. Francis Ford Coppola's crime drama sequel, starring Al Pacino, Andy Garcia, Diane Keaton, Talia Shire, Eli Wallach and Bridget Fonda.

programme.title: Puss In Boots: The Last Wish
programme.desc: The swashbuckling cat joins forces with sexy pickpocket Kitty Softpaws and lovable stray dog Perrito to journey deep into the Dark Forest. They attempt to locate the fabled Wishing Star, which can restore his spent lives. Animated comedy, with the voices of Antonio Banderas and Salma Hayek.

programme.title: A Ghost Story for Christmas: The Room in the Tower
programme.desc: For 15 years, Roger Winstanley has been haunted by an unsettling dream - an invitation to spend the night in the house of an acquaintance, where an unseen terror lurks, and figures who populate the dream seem to age in real time. Nightmare and waking life appear to collide when an invitation to the dreaded 'room in the tower' becomes all too real. Writer-director Mark Gatiss's adaptation of the EF Benson story, starring Tobias Menzies and Joanna Lumley.

programme.title: MasterChef
programme.sub-title: MasterChef Festive Extravaganza: Champion of Champions
programme.desc: A quartet of previous winners - Natalie Coleman, Thomas Frake, Chariya Khattiyot and Brin Pirathapan - re-enter the kitchen to compete in a festive culinary showdown. At stake is the golden pan trophy and their reputation. All they need to do is serve up a show-stopping dish fit for royalty, then present two of the best courses they have ever cooked, demonstrating how far they have progressed since they first entered the competition as amateurs. To help them decide the winner, judges Grace Dent and John Torode will be joined by restaurant critic Tom Parker Bowles.

programme.title: This Is BBC Two
programme.desc: Preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: Celebrity Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Singer, musician and actor Chesney Hawkes looks for a rural hideaway, to escape the bright lights and big stages. Jules Hudson has a selection of chart-topping character homes and is optimistic that the Cotswolds countryside will be a smash-hit for rockstar Chesney and his wife Krissy, along with their three grown-up children. On the billing are exquisite interiors, cottage charm and property perfection, but can Jules persuade Chesney to swap leather for tweed at the manorial Mystery House?

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents a round-up of unseen treasures from the past series, including a mask from Phantom of the Opera, Queen Victoria's parasol and a telegram from Ringo Starr to one of Scotland's foremost Scottish folk singers, Rab Noakes. Plus, in Stoke-on-Trent, Fiona pays a visit to the V&A Wedgwood Collection.

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Arsenal v Aston Villa at Emirates Stadium and Manchester United v Wolverhampton Wanderers at Old Trafford. Arsenal will be hoping to be crowned champions for the first time since 2004 this term, but had failed to win at home to the Villans in each of the last two seasons. The Red Devils lost home and away to Wolves in 2024/25, but the Midlanders have struggled in the current campaign. Plus, Burnley v Newcastle United, Chelsea v Bournemouth, Nottingham Forest v Everton and West Ham United v Brighton & Hove Albion.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek Brockway heads off on two more walks. First, he explores a winter wonderland with a trip through Snowdonia, before braving a blizzard over Blorenge mountain for a ramble in the Blaenavon World Heritage Park.(New).

programme.title: Nature's Weirdest Events
programme.desc: Chris Packham explores unusual and unexplained natural events that occur around the world during winter, enlisting the aid of leading scientists to uncover why these strange events happen. The programme examines unusual weather conditions, including tornadoes made of snow, and animals behaving in unexpected ways, from snowboarding crows to penguins attempting death-defying feats.

programme.title: Funny Girl
programme.desc: Musical biopic of 1920s singer and comedienne Fanny Brice, who rose from poor beginnings in New York's slums to become an overnight star and the toast of Broadway. Her success, however, came at the price of a turbulent private life and an unhappy marriage to a gambler, who grew increasingly jealous of her fame. Starring an Oscar-winning Barbra Streisand, with Omar Sharif, Kay Medford and Walter Pidgeon.

programme.title: West Side Story
programme.desc: Two teenagers from rival New York street gangs, the Jets and the Sharks, fall in love - but it causes already simmering tensions to explode. Leonard Bernstein and Stephen Sondheim's Oscar-winning musical adapted from their own stage production, starring Natalie Wood, Richard Beymer, Russ Tamblyn, Rita Moreno and George Chakiris.

programme.title: Kiss Me, Kate
programme.desc: From the Barbican Centre in London, Line of Duty's Adrian Dunbar and Broadway royalty Stephanie J Block lead a stellar cast in a production of Cole Porter's musical comedy. Filmed especially for the big screen and accompanied by a full orchestra, the show-tune classics keep coming - from Brush Up Your Shakespeare to Too Darn Hot, Always True to You (In My Fashion) and Tom, Dick or Harry.(New).

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.sub-title: Top of the Pops Review of the Year 2025
programme.desc: Clara Amfo looks back over the past 12 months in music, presenting performances by some of the biggest artists of 2025. Highlights include Mercury Prize winner Sam Fender and breakout star Lola Young at Radio 1's Big Weekend in Liverpool's Sefton Park. Plus, Lewis Capaldi's surprise slot at the Glastonbury Festival, chart record breaker Olivia Dean on Later? with Jools Holland, and some of the stories of the year from women taking over the headline slots at music festivals, with the likes of Olivia Rodrigo and Chappell Roan topping the bill at Glastonbury and Reading Festival respectively. Jarvis Cocker reflects on his band Pulp making a return after 24 years, and US rising stars Ravyn Lenae and Alex Warren discuss having two of the biggest selling songs of the year.(New).

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Alex Brooker, Rhys Darby, Joanna Page and Molly Rainford test their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games for a special festive show.(New).

Drag performer Tia Kofi, actress Lauren Patel, comedian Josh Jones, and TV presenter and auctioneer Izzie Balmer answer questions on the Christopher Eccleston incarnation of Doctor Who, the Oscar-winning film musical La La Land, Lady Jane Grey, and guinea pigs.(New).

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Winners of the third-place play-offs from two different series compete against each other - the Poptimists and the Ramblers. Victoria Coren Mitchell presents.(New).

programme.title: Christmas University Challenge
programme.desc: It's the first semi-final of this special all-star seasonal series. Two of the highest-scoring winning teams from the heats return to play again. Amol Rajan asks the questions.(New).

programme.desc: The last wooden lifeboat leaves and the passengers and crew face their fates, with reactions ranging from the captain's shocked resignation, to designer Andrews' desperate bid to help others. Those in the lifeboats watch in horror as explosions boom, sparks fly and Titanic splits in two, with the lifeboat occupants facing a dilemma - to risk saving others or to prioritise their own survival.(New).

programme.desc: Six unemployed men from Sheffield decide to become strippers for one night only in a bid to raise extra money. However, with no dancing experience and far from perfect physiques, the men rely on the unique selling point of complete nudity to impress the punters. Comedy, starring Robert Carlyle, Mark Addy, Tom Wilkinson, Hugo Speer and Paul Barber.

programme.desc: Jools Holland and his Rhythm & Blues Orchestra welcome in the new year with a stellar line-up of guests, including Rolling Stones guitarist Ronnie Wood, chart star Olivia Dean, veteran singer Lulu - performing her 1974 version of David Bowie's The Man Who Sold the World - and Jessie J, with her crowd-pleaser Living My Best Life. Also appearing are torch singer Imelda May, garage star Craig David, soul diva Heather Small, Brighton band the Kooks, boogie woogie queen Ruby Turner, Mercury Prize-nominated pianist Joe Webb and swing drummer David Hemlin.(New).(n)

programme.desc: A journey through the BBC's music archives for a selection of songs from the year, including Kylie Minogue's I Should Be So Lucky as well as hits for Salt-N-Pepa, Terence Trent D'Arby and Glenn Medeiros. Plus, Milli Vanilli had the world at their feet in 1988, but ultimately ended up pop pariahs after the lip-synching scandal that exposed the fact that Girl You Know It's True was actually a big lie.(n)

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: New host Sophie Willan presents this festive special, inviting Strictly judge Anton Du Beke, comedian Lucy Beaumont, actress Susan Wokoma and Tom Wilson - better known to Gladiators fans as Hammer - to take part in a trio of sewing challenges. They must put their own twist on a pattern for a Santa present sack, turn second-hand party wear into outfits based on The Twelve Days of Christmas and create clothing for models inspired by their favourite seasonal treat. Judges Esme Young and Patrick Grant keep a close eye on every stitch and hem and decide which famous face deserves the festive title.(n)

programme.desc: Wildlife cameraman Gordon Buchanan goes in search of wild horses in Canada's Rocky Mountains, finding a family group of two competing stallions, two mares and their two young foals. To understand more about the horses, and this unusual family dynamic in particular, Gordon immerses himself into their world, attempting to befriend them, earn their trust and experience their lives from within the herd, something that hasn't been attempted before.(n)

programme.desc: Derek Brockway treks along the Pembrokeshire coastal path in search of beaches and bluebells, before heading from east to west in an attempt to find the best springtime trails in Wales.(n)

However, he only discovers the truth about her feelings when it is too late. Romantic drama directed by Max Ophuls, starring Joan Fontaine, Louis Jourdan, Marcel Journet, Mady Christians and Howard Freeman.(n)

programme.title: New Year's Day Concert

Along the way, he uncovers items from the Bargain Hunt archive and counts down the most profitable pieces at auction. Plus, a host of Bargain Hunt experts join him to look back at items of furniture that competing teams have bought down the years.(n)

However, his increasingly torn loyalties leave him close to madness. Oscar-winning epic drama directed by David Lean, starring Peter O'Toole, Omar Sharif, Anthony Quinn, Alec Guinness and Jack Hawkins.(n)

Plus, Crystal Palace v Fulham and Brentford v Tottenham Hotspur.(n)

programme.title: Love Actually
programme.desc: Ten interlinked stories of people searching for and finding love. While the newly elected, bachelor British prime minister is smitten by a junior staff member at 10 Downing Street, a heartbroken writer heads for France to get over a failed relationship, and a faded rock star aims to reinvent himself in time for Christmas. Richard Curtis's romantic comedy, with Hugh Grant, Martine McCutcheon, Emma Thompson, Alan Rickman, Colin Firth, Bill Nighy and Liam Neeson.

Spy adventure, starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry, Toby Stephens, Judi Dench and John Cleese. Directed by Lee Tamahori, who died in November 2025.

However, the movie also inspired a whole generation of marine biologists to specialise in sharks and this documentary reveals that much more is known now about this misunderstood species than ever before.

The naturalist explores the evolution of vertebrates over the past 500 million years, beginning with a look at how remarkable advances allowed primitive fish to make the radical move on to land, and then take to the skies with the advent of flight. He uses fossils of both ancient and living species combined with CGI and film to chart their journey out of the water to populate all corners of the globe.

He traces their journey from humble origins as tiny nocturnal forest-dwellers to their astonishing explosion in diversity and domination of the world following the death of the dinosaurs.

He also learns about a complex community of animals, as well as the annual coral spawning, which is responsible for the great diversity in the reef.

He also marvels at manta ray cleaning stations on Lady Elliot Island, and tracks dwarf minke whales to discover their surprising reasons for returning, and why the reef is vital for their survival.

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The naturalist examines what the next few decades may hold for this remarkable ecosystem, and looks at the work of scientists who are trying to preserve the area and the species that inhabit it, assisted by research vessel the Alucia. He also embarks on an ambitious attempt to dive further into the reef than ever before to witness the resilient coral that live down in the depths and see if they hold answers that may help to overcome challenges that lie ahead, as the impact of humans on the reef continues to take its toll.

programme.desc: Alan Cumming discovers more little-known facts on a journey between Smithfields and Spitalfields, two of London's most famous markets. He begins with a fry-up breakfast before visiting the remains of a Roman amphitheatre and investigating a mysterious secret in a Liverpool Street hotel, as well as meeting former EastEnders star Larry Lamb (Archie Mitchell).

programme.title: Urban Secrets
programme.desc: Alan Cumming explores Newcastle, discovering strange sounds by the river and finding out how traditional culture is being reinterpreted in the Byker district. He goes behind the scenes at Newcastle United with local football hero Peter Beardsley, learns about the history of adult comic Viz from former editor Simon Donald and accompanies comedienne Sarah Millican to her favourite part of the city.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Steve Coogan is commissioned to review half a dozen restaurants for a Sunday newspaper and plans the trip with his American girlfriend - only to face the prospect of a week of meals-for-one after she dumps him. So Steve calls old friend Rob Brydon to accompany him, and the pair find themselves debating the big questions of life over a series of delightful dishes. Improvised comedy in which the stars play versions of themselves, directed by Michael Winterbottom.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Steve and Rob enjoy a taster menu at L'Enclume in the Cumbrian village of Cartmel as they continue their culinary tour of the north of England, reviewing restaurants for a Sunday newspaper. Comedy, starring Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Steve and Rob continue their culinary tour of the north of England in the Lake District.
