programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Steve and Rob visit Hipping Hall near Kirkby Lonsdale in Cumbria as they continue their culinary tour of the north of England, and are joined for a meal by Steve's agent Emma and Spanish photographer Yolanda. Comedy, starring Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Steve and Rob visit the world-famous Malham limestone pavement and eat at the Yorke Arms, as they continue their culinary tour of the north of England, reviewing restaurants for a Sunday newspaper. Comedy, starring Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: The duo visit Bolton Abbey and eat breakfast at the Angel Inn at Hetton in North Yorkshire. On the journey back to London from their culinary tour of the north of England, they stop off at Steve's parents' house. Comedy, starring Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Sequel to improvised comedy The Trip, with Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon once again playing versions of themselves. The two comedy actors are asked to embark on another round of restaurant reviews for a Sunday newspaper, this time in Italy. Steve is on hiatus from his American TV series and isn't drinking while Rob is looking to unwind with his time away from his young family. They begin their trip in Piedmont at the Trattoria Della Posta before stopping at the poet Byron's former house in Genoa on their way to the Cenobio dei Dogi in Camogli. Michael Winterbottom directs.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Rob and Steve go on a boat trip, stopping off at the poet Shelley's house for a photo before continuing their journey and arriving at another restaurant. Rob goes for a walk on the beach with the woman running the excursion and asks how she ended up working on a boat in Italy, and confesses he is missing his young daughter. Comedy, starring Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Steve and Rob visit Viareggio in Tuscany, where the poet Shelley's body was washed ashore after he drowned, and have lunch at Trattoria Albana in Mazzolla. Later, Rob gets a phone call from his agent about a potential part in a film. Comedy, starring Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Steve's assistant Emma joins him and Rob in Rome, where they also meet up with photographer Yolanda before visiting the Keats-Shelley Memorial House museum. They go on to their next restaurant, where Emma has a bit of news for them, and Rob and Steve compete with each other doing impressions of Marlon Brando's Don Corleone from The Godfather. Comedy, starring Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Steve and Rob visit Pompeii and then have lunch at Relais Blu on the Sorrento coast, overlooking the isle of Capri. Continuing their journey by car they head to the next hotel, where Rob receives a call from his agent telling him he has got the part in the movie he auditioned for. Comedy, starring Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Steve's son Joe and his assistant Emma join him and Rob on the final leg of their culinary tour of Italy as they take the ferry from Naples to Capri, where they have lunch at Il Riccio. Afterwards, Rob asks Emma for advice about whether he should go back to Lucy, while Steve tells Joe he is going to buy a house closer to him. Comedy, starring Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon.

programme.title: Amadeus
programme.desc: Gifted composer Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart moves to Vienna, destined for success and falling in love with soprano Constanze Weber. He soon meets esteemed court composer Antonio Salieri and secures his first opera commission from Emperor Joseph II. But when Salieri hears his music, he publicly dismisses Amadeus' talent, who in turn mocks Salieri's sexual stiffness. Maddened, Salieri then vows to kill Mozart. Historical drama based on Peter Shaffer's play starring Will Sharpe and Paul Bettan.

programme.title: Amadeus
programme.desc: After Salieri fails to coerce Constanze into bed in exchange for the pupillage of Princess Elizabeth, he tells her of her husband's adultery. While trying to make peace with his father in Salzburg, Amadeus hears of his infant son's death.

programme.title: Amadeus
programme.desc: The grief-stricken Mozarts are barely communicating with each other, while Salieri is promoted and assumes more power to pull the strings against Amadeus's success. Receiving another commission, Amadeus is inspired by a contentious banned book, leaving Vienna and Constanze to compose in secret. As war brews, Salieri plants a spy on the Mozarts and then organises a riot at Amadeus's opening night.

programme.title: Amadeus
programme.desc: The composer debuts Don Giovanni, inspired by his father's death, while Constanze leaves him for her lover. Deciding to finally seal Amadeus's fate, Salieri shuts down Mozart's opera and pursues him to the cheap vaudeville playhouse he has been forced to work in, setting him up for yet another failure.

programme.title: Amadeus
programme.desc: Constanze finally uncovers the truth about her husband's death and ensures that Mozart is always remembered, and that Salieri is never forgotten.

programme.title: Fish Town
programme.desc: Pat Seddon considers selling up and visits a clairvoyant, while celebrity chef Mitch Tonks makes an appearance at Brixham's Crab Festival.

Powerboat instructor Mike Weatherbee tries to enforce the laws of the sea, carpet-cleaner Dave Satchwill prepares to lead the town's popular ghost tour, and lone fisherman Dave Brown reveals his unusual methods.

Back in Jackson Hole, Joel seeks help to mend his relationship with Ellie. The return of the post-apocalyptic drama, starring Pedro Pascal and Bella Ramsey.

programme.title: The Last of Us
programme.desc: As a storm brews in the mountains, the residents of Jackson Hole prepare for the worst amid increased sightings of infected. Meanwhile, Abby weighs up her options.

programme.title: The Last of Us
programme.desc: After Dina shares crucial intelligence information, Ellie prepares to petition the town council. Near Seattle, a religious group flees a war. Post-apocalyptic drama, starring Bella Ramsey.

programme.title: The Last of Us
programme.desc: In Seattle, Ellie and Dina find themselves amid a brutal battle between the zealous Seraphites and a ruthless militia.

programme.title: The Last of Us
programme.desc: As the WLF makes a dangerous discovery, Ellie faces a key decision. An unlikely source shares a shocking truth.

programme.title: The Last of Us
programme.desc: Joel surprises Ellie for her birthday, while as their rift continues to widen she prepares to confront him about her past, and Joel makes a difficult choice out on patrol.

programme.title: The Last of Us
programme.desc: Amid the battle between Seattle's warring factions, Ellie's search draws her towards a devastating confrontation. Post-apocalyptic drama, starring Bella Ramsey.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Lord Eddard Stark is torn between his family and an old friend when he is asked to serve at the side of King Robert Baratheon. However, neither man is aware that their country is on the verge of a bitter power struggle that could lead to its destruction. First episode of the fantasy drama based on George RR Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire series of novels, starring Sean Bean, Mark Addy, Lena Headey and Emilia Clarke.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Bran clings to life as Ned prepares to head south with the king - only for the youngster to come under attack once more. Jon discovers a different side to Tyrion when he accompanies him on a journey to the Wall, while Daenerys becomes more assertive toward her new husband, the warlord Khal Drogo. Fantasy drama, starring Sean Bean, Mark Addy and Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Ned finally takes up his role at the side of the king, but struggles to deal with the political power games of Robert's cunning advisers. The weary lord is asked to organise a tournament, but finds the royal finances in a dire state - and his job is made even harder by troubling news from home. Meanwhile, Tyrion's visit to the Wall reveals the men of the Night's Watch are in desperate need of reinforcement, and relations between Daenerys and Viserys become increasingly strained. Fantasy drama, starring Sean Bean and Mark Addy.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Ned searches for the truth about Jon Arryn's death, but is far from certain he can trust Pycelle or Littlefinger. The balance of power between the exiled Targaryens shifts dramatically, Jon Snow befriends a vulnerable new recruit at the great Wall, and Bran's recovery is made more difficult by a series of disturbing dreams. Fantasy drama, starring Sean Bean, Aiden Gillen and Julian Glover.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Ned tries to stop Robert from entering the tournament after a suspicious death threatens to overshadow the event - and the competition is plunged into chaos when one of the favourites suffers a surprise defeat. Meanwhile, Catelyn takes the captive Tyrion east in search of refuge at the Eyrie, home of her sister Lysa. Fantasy drama, starring Sean Bean and Mark Addy.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Ned is reinstated by Robert and hears rumours that associates of the Lannisters have begun stirring up trouble across the Seven Kingdoms. Tyrion concocts a risky scheme to escape the Eyrie, Bran's first trip outside the castle since his accident nearly ends in tragedy, and Viserys causes uproar in Khal Drogo's home city. Drama, starring Sean Bean.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Lord Tywin readies his son Jaime for battle as House Lannister prepares for conflict, and Ned confronts Cersei about what he has learnt while investigating Jon Arryn's death. Meanwhile, at the Wall, Jon Snow waits to make his vows to the Night's Watch, and across the sea, Khal Drogo vows revenge on the Seven Kingdoms in response to the attempted assassination of Daenerys. Starring Charles Dance and Sean Bean.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Battle commences as the Lannisters launch their bid to seize the throne. Robb rounds up his allies as he prepares to confront Tywin's troops, while Tyrion forms an unlikely alliance with a savage tribe. At King's Landing, Arya and Syrio are forced to fight for their lives, and a sinister new enemy emerges at Castle Black. Meanwhile, Daenerys tries to reconcile her lust for power with the shocking brutality of war.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Ned struggles to endure his imprisonment at the hands of the Lannisters, and faces a fateful decision to save Sansa's life - while Catelyn negotiates a deal with an unreliable ally. Tyrion's father forces him to take to the battlefield, Robb seeks to prove his mettle in combat, and Daenerys' power comes under threat as Drogo's condition worsens. Fantasy drama, starring Sean Bean and Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Robb's bannermen make a declaration that threatens to throw Westeros into disarray. Catelyn confronts Jaime Lannister about Bran's near-fatal fall, Arya tries to flee the capital, and Tywin sends Tyrion on a surprising assignment. Jon Snow struggles to decide where his loyalties lie, and Daenerys tries to rebuild her life after a tragic event. Fantasy drama, starring Richard Madden and Michelle Fairley.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: The seven kingdoms of Westeros prepare for all-out war as newly crowned King in the North Robb Stark marches south to avenge his father. Tyrion Lannister arrives in King's Landing to curb the excesses of teenage tyrant Joffrey, and Stannis Baratheon, brother of the late King Robert, sets his sights on the Iron Throne. Fantasy drama based on George RR Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire novels, starring Stephen Dillane, Richard Madden, Peter Dinklage and Jack Gleeson.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Tyrion turns his anger on Cersei for alienating Joffrey's subjects in the wake of the capital's bloody purge, and Theon returns to the Iron Islands for first time in nine years, where he discovers his father Balon is planning to rebel against the crown once again. Arya shares a secret with her new friend Gendry while travelling north to the Wall, and Davos Seaworth recruits an ally who may prove useful in Stannis Baratheon's naval invasion of King's Landing.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.sub-title: What Is Dead May Never Die
programme.desc: Tyrion strengthens his position as Hand of the King with a risky gambit devised to identify the member of the small council in league with his sister Cersei, while at Winterfell, Maester Luwin tries to help Bran make sense of his dreams. Catelyn travels to the Stormlands to foster an alliance with the Baratheons, but King Renly, his new wife Margaery Tyrell and her brother Ser Loras have other plans. Fantasy drama, starring Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Robb Stark's chain of victories against the Lannisters enrages Joffrey, who punishes Sansa for her brother's successes. Tyrion struggles to find a way to curb his nephew's cruel excesses and enlists Cersei's lover Lancel as an informant. Catelyn urges the Baratheon brothers to forgo their ambitions and unite against a common enemy, while across the Narrow Sea, Daenerys and her exhausted retinue arrive at the walled city of Qarth.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Catelyn is forced to flee when the Baratheon brothers' rivalry comes to a bloody end, and Lord Baelish spots an opportunity to further his own ambitions. Tyrion discovers Joffrey is planning to use a secret weapon to defend his seat of power, and Theon sails for the Stony Shore to prove his worth as a Greyjoy. Arya receives a favour from the man she freed from Harrenhal, and the Night's Watch arrives at the Fist of the First Men to stem the advance of the wildling army.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.sub-title: The Old Gods and the New
programme.desc: King Joffrey's tyrannical rule prompts the people of King's Landing to riot, with near devastating consequences for Sansa. Meanwhile, beyond the Wall, Qhorin gives Jon a chance to prove himself. and across the Narrow Sea, Daenerys' resolve strengthens as she vows to reclaim what she believes is rightfully hers. Fantasy drama, starring Emilia Clarke.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Theon's determination to prove his Ironborn status prompts him to embark on a hunt. Fantasy drama, starring Alfie Allen, Emilia Clarke and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: King in the North Robb Stark is incensed when he learns he has been betrayed by one of his closest friends, while his fugitive sister Arya calls in a debt, leaving mysterious convict Jaqen H'ghar with a difficult decision to make. Meanwhile, across the Narrow Sea, Daenerys is presented with a dilemma as she struggles to negotiate with the seemingly egalitarian lords of Qarth.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: King Joffrey's days on the Iron Throne appear to be numbered as Stannis lays claim to his late brother Robert's realm with a naval assault on King's Landing. The realities of all-out war leave the young tyrant reeling, and it is left to his sharp-witted uncle Tyrion to launch a defensive strategy that could save his family and decide the fate of the seven battle-scarred kingdoms of Westeros. Jack Gleeson, Peter Dinklage and Stephen Dillane star in an episode written by George RR Martin, whose novels form the basis for the series.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Theon Greyjoy stirs his men into action as Maester Luwin offers some final advice, Arya receives a gift from the mysterious Jaqen, and Daenerys summons the courage to enter the House of the Undying. Meanwhile, Jon proves his worth as a brother of the Night's Watch to Qhorin Halfhand. Fantasy drama, based on George RR Martin's Song of Ice and Fire novels, and starring Maisie Williams, Kit Harington and Alfie Allen.

programme.title: Game of Thrones

Across the Narrow Sea, Daenerys Targaryen arrives in Slaver's Bay with adviser Ser Jorah Mormont looking to form an army. Fantasy drama based on George RR Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire series of novels, starring Peter Dinklage, Emilia Clarke and Kit Harington.

Fantasy drama based on George RR Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire series of novels, starring Maisie Williams, Conleth Hill and Emilia Clarke.

Fantasy drama, starring Emilia Clarke, Charles Dance and Jack Gleeson.

Across the Narrow Sea, Daenerys picks a champion to take on the best that Meereen has to offer and Davos has an idea about raising funds for Stannis's cause.

Fantasy drama, starring Lena Headey, Charles Dance, Emilia Clarke and Kit Harington.

programme.desc: Tyrion enlists an unlikely ally, while Daario entreats Daenerys to allow him to do what he does best. Fantasy drama, starring Peter Dinklage, Kit Harington and Emilia Clarke.

Fantasy drama, starring Peter Dinklage and Pedro Pascal.

Fantasy drama, starring Kit Harington and directed by Neil Marshall, the man behind the second series episode depicting the Battle of the Blackwater.

Fantasy drama based on George RR Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire series of novels, starring Peter Dinklage and Emilia Clarke.

Starring Kit Harington, Lena Headey, Peter Dinklage and Emilia Clarke.

programme.sub-title: The House of Black and White

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: The militant arm of the Faith of the Seven grows more aggressive, Jaime and Bronn head south and Ellaria and the Sand Snakes vow vengeance.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Jon enlists the help of an unexpected ally, Daenerys makes a difficult decision in Mereen, Brienne searches for Sansa, and Theon remains under Ramsay's control.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Arya continues her training at the House of Black and White, Jorah and Tyrion run into slavers and the Sand Snakes mount an attack. Fantasy, starring Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Jon prepares for conflict, Sansa tries to talk to Theon, and Brienne waits for a sign. Elsewhere, Jaime attempts to reconnect with his family.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Arya makes progress in her training, Sansa confronts an old friend, Cersei faces a struggle and Jon embarks on a journey. Fantasy drama, starring Lena Headey.

programme.desc: In Westeros, Jon returns to the Wall from his controversial ranging mission, and Stannis faces a difficult decision. Fantasy drama, starring Kit Harington, Stephen Dillane, Maisie Williams and Emilia Clarke.

Starring Kit Harington, Emilia Clarke, Lena Headey and Stephen Dillane.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: The fate of Jon Snow is revealed, Ramsay sends his dogs after Theon and Sansa, while Ellaria and the Sand Snakes make their move.

programme.desc: Bran trains with the Three-Eyed Raven, while in the north of Westeros at Castle Black, the Night's Watch stands behind Alliser Thorne. Fantasy drama, starring Isaac Hempstead-Wright and Owen Teale.

programme.desc: While Daenerys meets her future, Bran meets the past. Elsewhere, Tommen confronts the High Sparrow, and Arya continues her training. Starring Emilia Clarke, Maisie Williams and Isaac Hempstead-Wright.

programme.desc: The fantasy drama continues as Tyrion strikes a deal, while Jorah and Daario undertake a difficult task as they seek to catch up with Daenerys. Fantasy drama, starring Peter Dinklage, Gwendoline Christie, Maisie Williams and Isaac Hempstead Wright.

Fantasy drama, starring Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, John Bradley, Hannah Murray and Maisie Williams.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: The High Sparrow eyes another target, Jaime confronts a hero, and Olenna Tyrell plans to leave King's Landing. Meanwhile, Arya makes a plan.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: As Jaime weighs up his options, Cersei answers a request, and Tyrion's plans bear fruit. Starring Lena Headey, Peter Dinklage and Emilia Clarke.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: As the Starks prepare to fight, Davos loses something dear, while Ramsay plays a game and Daenerys faces a choice.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: As Cersei awaits judgement, Walder Frey and Jaime celebrate at Riverrun. Meanwhile, winter finally arrives. Lena Headey, Peter Dinklage and Emilia Clarke star.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Jon organises the North's defences, Cersei tries to even the odds, Daenerys comes home and Arya reminds the Freys that the North remembers. Sam adapts to life in Oldtown, and the Night King makes his way south.

programme.title: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: Daenerys receives an unexpected visitor, while Jon faces resistance and Tyrion plans the conquest of Westeros. Cersei gathers her allies, Arya has a reunion with old friends and Sam risks his career and life.

programme.desc: Jon arrives at Dragonstone and finally meets Daenerys, but refuses her demand that he bend the knee to her. Cersei gains a new ally, Sansa receives an unexpected visitor and Sam is confronted for his actions.

programme.desc: Arya returns to Winterfell and is reunited with Sansa and Bran, while Daenerys takes matters into her own hands and launches a surprise attack on the Lannister army. Jaime and Bronn collect the spoils from the war with the Tyrells.

Animated comedy sequel, with the voices of Steve Carell and Kristen Wiig.

Animated comedy, with the voices of Sandra Bullock, Pierre Coffin, Jon Hamm and Michael Keaton.

So he and his over-friendly - and slightly irritating - neighbour Dev set off on a journey across the country as they try to track down the last remaining toy in the whole of the UK, which happens to be 300 miles away in Carlisle. Festive comedy, starring Stephen Merchant and Asim Chaudhry.

In the midst of all this mayhem, Conor's mother Mairead is rushed to hospital, and may be more seriously ill than previously thought. When she says she wants to see a white Christmas, the lads vow to make her wish come true - with a little help from Sheehan, who is shooting a film nearby.

programme.title: The Young Offenders

Conor is still a novice at domestic housework, including washing, so Mairéad decides to give him lessons, clearing out his wash basket thoroughly - only to discover a handgun in the basket. Seasonal episode of the comedy drama, starring Alex Murphy, Hilary Rose and Dominic MacHale, with a guest appearance by celebrity chef Rachel Allen.

Hoping it will make Stephen care about teaching more than he ever did, Alfie tells Stephen he will be visited by three ghosts to show him the error of his ways but his happiness depends on the lessons he learns that night and the decision he has to make about his career at Abbey Grove. Jack Whitehall returns for a festive musical-themed episode, with Layton Williams and Charlie Wernham.

programme.desc: The newlyweds begin leading separate lives back in their home towns. In Essex, Smithy makes efforts to remind Gavin of the excitement of his bachelor years with a traditional boys' night out. Meanwhile in Barry, Stacey tries to distract herself with a trip to the bingo.

programme.title: Gavin & Stacey
programme.desc: Nessa goes into labour a month early in Barry, and the newlyweds must forget their differences to track down Smithy in time for the birth of his child. Meanwhile, Stacey returns to Essex to salvage her marriage.

programme.title: The Catch Up

However, a sinister taxidermist intends to turn him into a museum exhibit. Comedy based on Michael Bond's series of children's books, starring Hugh Bonneville, Sally Hawkins and Nicole Kidman, with the voice of Ben Whishaw.

While the Browns try to clear Paddington's name, he tries to make himself at home in prison, winning over the other convicts and getting involved in an escape attempt. Comedy adventure, starring Hugh Bonneville, Hugh Grant and Sally Hawkins, with Ben Whishaw providing the voice of Paddington.

programme.desc: Amanda organises her annual festive soiree, complete with a strict code of conduct on when and where to drink mulled wine and an evil Santa. For Julia, the party is a welcome distraction from hosting her in-laws, while Liz is trying to ignore Christmas altogether and Kevin is single-handedly stuffing, wrapping, roasting, parboiling, laying up, washing up and decorating everything he can lay his hands on.

programme.title: Motherland
programme.desc: Julia has a full house on Christmas Day with an influx of grandparents, not to mention Kevin and Liz. Across the road Meg questions whether her husband really knows her at all and gets stuck into the booze - but soon regrets it. Amanda grits her teeth as she spends the day with ex-husband Johnny and his new wife Tamara, while Anne is beside herself with excitement as she welcomes her mammy and cousins - all 32 of them.

programme.desc: The family heads to Aunt Joan's country house for Christmas, but things fall apart when Mal and Anne tag along and Amanda struggles to recreate the magic from her youth. Anne is in despair at being separated from her family and Felicity is increasingly irritated by her sister's high spirits, while Mal finds a hidden photo that appears to reveal a deep family secret. Richard Curtis's comedy, with Hugh Grant, Andie MacDowell, John Hannah, Charlotte Coleman, Kristin Scott Thomas, Simon Callow and James Fleet.

programme.desc: Everyone gathers in Billericay as Pete and Dawn prepare to renew their wedding vows. programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: Bono is being bullied by another boy at school so his grandmother steps in to sort things out in her inimitable style. Cathy's new French boyfriend doesn't make a great first impression, which could be a problem if he is to survive meeting Mrs Brown, and Grandad is back from hospital with a new stairlift - and a prescription for marijuana. Comedy, starring Brendan O'Carroll.(n)

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: Father Damien organises a neighbourhood patrol to tackle the rising amount of crime in Finglas, but it quickly becomes clear that Agnes and Winnie are not exactly cut out for catching criminals. Second of two festive specials, starring Brendan O'Carroll, Eilish O'Carroll and Jennifer Gibney.(n)

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: The doting mother offers Winnie and Sharon a place to stay when the pipes in their house burst, but Agnes and Cathy soon discover that living with best friends isn't as much fun as they thought it would be. As if that wasn't enough for Agnes to cope with, she is asked by Father Damian to do a eulogy for a neighbour she never knew and there's Bono's 13th birthday party to host as well.(n)

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: Agnes discovers that Peggy Piper, the Pernod poisoner, is being released from prison and could be coming back to town - which is bad news for Winnie as she was the one who saw her old friend poison her husband and gave the evidence that put her behind bars in the first place. Meanwhile, Dermot hires an expensive tank costume for his latest promotion - only for Buster to go and lose it. Comedy, starring Brendan O'Carroll, Dermot O'Neill, Jennifer Gibney, Gary Hollywood and guest starring Sue Vincent.(n)

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: Winnie has not been sleeping well, and wants to tell Agnes about her dreams, so when her house is later burgled and her mother's wedding ring stolen, Buster and Dermot plan to take matters into their own hands to expose the thief. Cathy has a significant birthday coming up - and is far from happy about it.(n)

programme.title: BBC Comedy Short Films
programme.desc: Short comedy film starring Luke Rollason. A social media meltdown forces Geoffrey to reassses his life and values.(n)

programme.desc: Teenager Marty McFly travels back to the 1950s in a time machine built by his eccentric inventor friend. Sci-fi comedy adventure, starring Michael J Fox, Christopher Lloyd, Lea Thompson and Crispin Glover.(n)

programme.title: Back to the Future Part II

However, this proves to have unforeseen consequences when the future version of arch enemy Biff sees a chance to rewrite history for his own benefit, leaving Marty stuck in a twisted parallel universe. Sci-fi comedy sequel, starring Michael J Fox and Christopher Lloyd.(n)

programme.desc: A young strait-laced couple stranded during a storm take shelter in an eerie castle, where they are enticed into the weird world of a menagerie of debauched characters - presided over by a mad sex-crazed transvestite scientist - and undergo a startling transformation as they let go of their inhibitions. Cult musical, starring Tim Curry, Susan Sarandon, Barry Bostwick and the show's creator, Richard O'Brien.

programme.title: The Read
programme.sub-title: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Actor Steffan Rhodri gives a reading of CS Lewis's timeless story The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe. When young Second World War evacuee Lucy Pevensie hides in an old wardrobe during a game of hide-and-seek, she finds herself transported to Narnia, a land frozen in an eternal winter by the evil White Witch. Lucy and her siblings, Peter, Susan and Edmund, fight alongside the noble lion Aslan to defeat the witch and her army.

programme.title: BBC Classical: Best of 2025
programme.desc: Highlights from 2025's classical music on the BBC with treats from the BBC Proms, Cardiff Singer of the World celebration concert, the New Year's Day extravaganza from Vienna, and selected archive performances. Danielle de Niese gives a rendition of Habanera from Bizet's Carmen, while the BBC Concert Orchestra plunges the Proms audience into a tidal wave of emotion with the theme from Jaws. Also, all the excitement from the Last Night of the Proms.(New).

programme.title: Lesley Garrett at the BBC
programme.desc: A tribute to the voice and career of soprano Lesley Garrett, who shares her memories of some of her finest performances from a career full of BBC moments. This collection includes popular songs such as 'Somewhere' and 'Tonight,' and showcases the versatility, artistry, and warmth that have made Lesley Garrett one of Britain's most cherished performers.(New).

programme.title: The Best of Lesley Garrett Tonight
programme.desc: Highlights from the popular soprano's 1999 series, with guests including Bryn Terfel, Darcey Bussell, Andrea Bocelli, Gary Barlow, Michael Ball and Lily Savage. First broadcast in 2000.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: A festive edition of the pop show from 1985, when the Christmas number one was Merry Christmas Everyone by Shakin' Stevens. Other acts enjoying chart success included a-Ha, Jennifer Rush, Madonna, Sister Sledge, Paul Hardcastle and Feargal Sharkey, while two of the year's biggest hits were duets - David Bowie and Mick Jagger's cover of Dancing in the Street, and I Know Him So Well by Elaine Paige and Barbara Dickson.

programme.title: 40 Hits of 1985 at the BBC
programme.desc: A selection of songs from the year, featuring Queen, Simple Minds, Elton John, Prince, Duran Duran, Foreigner, Billy Ocean, Marillion, Go West, King, Strawberry Switchblade, Kirsty MacColl and Princess. There are also collaborations between Elaine Paige and Barbara Dickson, Phil Collins and Philip Bailey, Gary Moore and Phil Lynott, and Chrissie Hynde and UB40.

programme.title: Abba at the BBC
programme.desc: A collection of memorable performances by the group. Agnetha Faltskog, Bjorn Ulvaeus, Benny Andersson and Anni-Frid Lyngstad were thrust into the limelight in 1974 when Waterloo triumphed at the Eurovision Song Contest in Brighton, marking the start of their rise to fame. Various outings were captured by BBC cameras over the next few years and several are featured here alongside their Top of the Pops debut, archive interviews and footage featuring hits including Waterloo, Dancing Queen, Does Your Mother Know, Thank You for the Music, SOS, Fernando and Chiquitita. There is also a chance to see the foursome on a 1982 edition of Noel Edmonds' Late, Late Breakfast Show, which was Abba's last televised appearance in the UK.

programme.title: Top of the Pops

Meanwhile, Siegfried becomes nervous when an enormous wolfhound needs treatment. Peter Davison, Robert Hardy and Christopher Timothy star in a feature-length episode from 1990, marking an end to the rural drama.

programme.title: To the Manor Born

A special festive edition from 1979 of the comedy, starring Penelope Keith, Peter Bowles and Angela Thorne.

programme.title: Samuel West Remembers - Prunella Scales
programme.desc: The actor introduces a special night of BBC programmes that celebrate the life and work of his mother Prunella Scales, who died earlier this year at the age of 93. With contributions from her husband and son, the actors Timothy and Samuel West, as well as John Cleese and Andrew Sachs of Fawlty Towers and Marriage Lines co-star Richard Briers.

programme.title: A Question of Attribution
programme.desc: John Schlesinger's 1991 adaptation of Alan Bennett's play about the double life of former MI5 spy Anthony Blunt. Knighted after becoming Surveyor of the Queen's Pictures, Blunt life took a twist in 1964 when he confessed under interrogation to assisting the escape of Soviet spies Guy Burgess and Donald Maclean. Starring James Fox, with Prunella Scales and David Calder.

programme.title: Looking for Victoria
programme.desc: Dramatised documentary about Queen Victoria in which Prunella Scales looks back at the fascinating life of the monarch, visiting many of the houses and places in her life. This first of two parts charts Victoria's traumatic childhood years, coronation at the age of 18 and, barely a year later, marriage to her beloved first cousin Albert. With Timothy West , Charles Dance and Andrew Sachs.

programme.title: Looking for Victoria
programme.desc: Conclusion of the docudrama, with Prunella Scales revealing how Prince Albert's death deeply affected Queen Victoria, but she found comfort in her subsequent friendship with Scottish ghillie John Brown and Indian servant known as 1the Munshi'. With Andrew Sachs, Hugh Lloyd, David Ryall and historian Lucinda Lambton.

programme.title: The Best of Lesley Garrett Tonight
programme.desc: Highlights from the popular soprano's 1999 series, with guests including Bryn Terfel, Darcey Bussell, Andrea Bocelli, Gary Barlow, Michael Ball and Lily Savage. First broadcast in 2000.

Through music and drama, with no theatrical set or props, this play takes Holmes and Watson from the comfort of 221b Baker Street, and audiences from the auditorium, to the moors of the Baskerville Hall estate in this chilling, gripping and hair-raising version of the legendary tale.

programme.desc: The presenter dives deeper into Egypt's mysteries, exploring the Great Sphinx and the underground Serapeum with its precision-cut granite sarcophagi, questioning their purpose and links to the pyramid enigma. He concludes at the sprawling Karnak temple complex, marvelling at its monumental engineering, sphinx-lined avenues, and Hatshepsut's towering obelisk - wondering whether it's simply a monument or a channel for cosmic energy.

programme.title: Bradley Walsh: Egypt's Cosmic Code

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants

programme.title: David Attenborough's Conquest of the Skies
programme.desc: The veteran naturalist examines the world of flight, travelling across the globe to chart the evolutionary story of those creatures who seemingly defy the rules of gravity by taking to the air. Initially focusing on insects, Attenborough meets a descendant of the dragonfly, before examining the Atlas beetle, which tends to restrict flight to times when it needs a mate or a fresh supply of food. More aesthetically pleasing is a group of beautiful tropical butterflies, followed by an in-depth study into the blow fly - the jet fighter of insects.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Conquest of the Skies
programme.desc: The veteran naturalist visits the jungles of Borneo to meet creatures that like to glide through life - the harlequin tree frog and the little-known colugo - often referred to, incorrectly, as a flying lemur. He also has a CGI-assisted encounter with the first true vertebrate flyer, the pterosaur, receives a flying lesson from a small flock of swans at Loch Lomond in Scotland and encounters the planet's largest species of bat.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Conquest of the Skies
programme.desc: The veteran naturalist turns his attention to creatures that dominate the skies today. He begins with the vast bird family, watching a group of vultures as they go scavenging and some peregrine falcons dive bombing for their prey. He then moves on to the floating forests of Ecuador to find out what makes the humble hummingbird tick, before ending his journey at the Gomantong bat caves of Borneo - a place he first filmed in 1972 - witnessing a mass exodus of the creatures.

programme.title: Attenborough at 90: Behind the Lens
programme.desc: A profile of broadcaster and naturalist David Attenborough, whose career has included being the first controller of BBC Two and making numerous groundbreaking wildlife programmes.

programme.title: Attenborough's Journey
programme.desc: Documentary following David Attenborough as he journeys around the world to make his series First Life, which explores the origins of life on Earth. As he visits locations including the Great Barrier Reef, the deserts of Morocco and the glaciers of Canada, the broadcaster and wildlife expert explains his life-long fascination with the natural world, and also travels back to Leicestershire, the county in which he spent his childhood.

programme.title: David Attenborough Meets Obama
programme.desc: Another chance to see Barack Obama's conversation, recorded in May 2015, with renowned naturalist and film-maker David Attenborough. In a twist on usual convention, the then-US president took the role of interviewer, quizzing Attenborough about his thoughts on the future of the planet, their shared passion for nature, and potential ways to protect the environment. Also includes behind-the-scenes footage from Sir David's latest project on the Great Barrier Reef, as well as highlights from throughout the veteran broadcaster's career.

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef with David Attenborough
programme.desc: Following his visit to the Great Barrier Reef in 1957, naturalist and broadcaster David Attenborough returns and uses the latest filming techniques to unlock the secrets of the natural wonder. In the first edition, he descends beneath the waves at night and uses cutting-edge technology to generate computer scans of the sea floor. He also learns about a complex community of animals, as well as the annual coral spawning, which is responsible for the great diversity in the reef.

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef with David Attenborough
programme.desc: Using the latest technology, the naturalist explores the shark-infested waters of Osprey Reef in the Triton submersible, before returning to the nesting grounds of the Green Sea Turtle, 60 years after his first visit to Raine Island. He also marvels at manta ray cleaning stations on Lady Elliot Island, and tracks dwarf minke whales to discover their surprising reasons for returning, and why the reef is vital for their survival.

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The naturalist examines what the next few decades may hold for this remarkable ecosystem, and looks at the work of scientists who are trying to preserve the area and the species that inhabit it, assisted by research vessel the Alucia. He also embarks on an ambitious attempt to dive further into the reef than ever before to witness the resilient coral that live down in the depths and see if they hold answers that may help to overcome challenges that lie ahead, as the impact of humans on the reef continues to take its toll.

programme.title: David Attenborough's First Life
programme.desc: In the first of a two-part documentary, the naturalist explores the origins of life on Earth. Beginning the journey near his childhood home in Charnwood Forest, Leicestershire, he learns how a fossil discovery transformed scientists' understanding of the evolution of complex organisms, and in Newfoundland and Australia he reveals the earliest kinds of animal to exist on the planet. With the help of cutting-edge technology and visual effects, the programme brings the creatures to life, demonstrating how they survived.

programme.title: David Attenborough's First Life
programme.desc: In the conclusion of the two-part documentary, the naturalist travels to Burgess Shale in Canada's Rocky Mountains, where he explores how evolution gained pace once creatures developed mouths and mobility. In Scotland, he reveals that one of the smallest fossils found holds the secret to how animals began surviving on dry land, and explains the bloom of life during the oxygen-rich Carboniferous period.

programme.title: The Bachelor King
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the lives of king penguins, filmed on the sub-Antarctic island of South Georgia over five months. The programme imagines what one penguin's life would be, following it during the challenging, awkward time between adolescence and adulthood. Presented by David Attenborough.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough employs the latest technologies to explore the violence, rivalries and deadly weaponry existing within the world of bugs. This first episode examines the survival tactics of its terrifying residents including killer ants, trap-setting spiders and beetles with the ability to shoot boiling chemicals at their enemies.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster continues his bug-eyed view of the world of creepy-crawlies, revealing how predators defuse the defences of their prey. Highlights include the cockroach wasp, busy preparing a tasty - and very live - treat for its young, the whirligig beetle, which employs a water-based radar system, and the jumping portia spider, which feeds on other arachnids.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: A further selection of creepy-crawly close-ups, focusing on courtship in the bug world. Highlights include scorpions shaking their booty, the perfume-wearing nasonia wasp and the tropical cricket, for whom romance goes out of the window as it uses bribery to seal the deal with would-be partners. One potential partner to steer well clear of, however, is the praying mantis, the female of which is notorious for eating the male just after - or even during - mating. Narrated by David Attenborough.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: A close-up view of sex, bug-style, as David Attenborough talks viewers through the different ways in which creepy-crawlies reproduce. Size matters for the minuscule male orb spider, creepily sneaking up on its intended and trying to mate without her noticing, while there's no rest for the lothario-like butterfly, which has plenty of notches on its proverbial bedpost. However, the harvestman spider has no use for sex at all, and reproduces by cloning itself.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough shifts the focus to bugs that prefer co-operation rather than conflict. They include burrowing cockroaches, the suitably named social spiders - which share a 30-metre web - the queen bee and her happy hive of workers and green ants pulling together to build a nest.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster concludes his close-up examination of the creepy-crawly world, shifting focus to the bugs' ultimate invention - the colony. Key residents of these minuscule mega-cities include honey bees, termites, leafcutter ants - who have a knack for farming - and their Argentine cousins, members of a community so vast it spans an entire continent.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Rise of Animals
programme.sub-title: From the Seas to the Skies
programme.desc: Part one of two. The naturalist explores the evolution of vertebrates over the past 500 million years, beginning with a look at how remarkable advances allowed primitive fish to make the radical move on to land, and then take to the skies with the advent of flight. He uses fossils of both ancient and living species combined with CGI and film to chart their journey out of the water to populate all corners of the globe.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Rise of Animals
programme.desc: The naturalist concludes his two-part exploration of the evolution of vertebrates over the past 500 million years by looking at the history of mammals. He traces their journey from humble origins as tiny nocturnal forest-dwellers to their astonishing explosion in diversity and domination of the world following the death of the dinosaurs.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: The broadcaster explores the Galapagos, a collection of volcanic islands in the Pacific known for its extraordinary wildlife. More than 150 years after Charles Darwin formulated his ground-breaking theory of evolution on the remote archipelago, Attenborough explains how life on the islands has continued to evolve in biological isolation, examining how the ever-changing volcanic landscape has given birth to species and sub-species that exist nowhere else in the world. He begins by revealing how Galapagos rose from the ocean four million years ago.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos

David investigates the driving forces behind their evolution, exploring the appearance and behaviour of remarkable creatures and vegetation including giant whale sharks, marine iguanas and seemingly normal dandelion seeds that grow into plants the size of trees.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos

programme.title: Gangs of Baboon Falls

programme.title: Gangs of Baboon Falls
programme.desc: As the Victoria gang struggle with lots of new mouths to feed, the Zambia gang must decide whether to let outcasts from outer town in.

programme.title: Becoming Orangutan

programme.title: Becoming Orangutan

programme.title: Shark with Steve Backshall

programme.title: Shark: British Isles Special with Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Naturalist Steve Backshall goes in search of some of the 30-plus shark species that inhabit waters of the British Isles, showing how the big fish in home waters are just as astonishing and mysterious as their global cousins. Along the way he encounters a four-ton basking shark near the Hebrides and dives with his favourite of all time, the blue shark, off the coast of Cornwall. He also meets scientists and conservationists in Wales who are working to protect endangered species.

programme.title: Gladiators

programme.title: Gladiators

programme.title: Gladiators

programme.title: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family
programme.desc: Part one of two. Biologist Patrick Aryee explores how cats have evolved throughout the millennia, learning to thrive in inhospitable environments, as well as becoming the world's most popular pet. In the first edition there is spectacular footage of caracals jumping three metres to catch flying birds, and a rare Bornean bay cat, which was thought to have been extinct. Patrick finds out how tigers made the transition from South-east Asia's steamy jungles to the -40C temperatures of Siberia, and meets 'lion whisperer' Kevin Richardson.

programme.title: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family
programme.desc: Patrick Aryee concludes his two-part exploration of the feline family tree, revealing how the Canadian lynx learned to thrive in the snow and spread out, evolving and inhabiting new parts of the Americas. In Belize, he mounts an experiment that showcases the margay's supersharp senses and gravity-defying acrobatics, and heads to the training track with a cheetah to find out what speed it is capable of. Finally, Patrick tells the story of the cat's domestication in Essaouira, Morocco, believed to be one of the first places where one particular species first gave up life in the wild in return for food, warmth, security and a home.

programme.desc: In the first of a two-part documentary, the naturalist explores the origins of life on Earth. Beginning the journey near his childhood home in Charnwood Forest, Leicestershire, he learns how a fossil discovery transformed scientists' understanding of the evolution of complex organisms, and in Newfoundland and Australia he reveals the earliest kinds of animal to exist on the planet. With the help of cutting-edge technology and visual effects, the programme brings the creatures to life, demonstrating how they survived.

programme.title: David Attenborough's First Life

In Scotland, he reveals that one of the smallest fossils found holds the secret to how animals began surviving on dry land, and explains the bloom of life during the oxygen-rich Carboniferous period.

programme.title: Attenborough's Journey
programme.desc: Documentary following David Attenborough as he journeys around the world to make his series First Life, which explores the origins of life on Earth. As he visits locations including the Great Barrier Reef, the deserts of Morocco and the glaciers of Canada, the broadcaster and wildlife expert explains his life-long fascination with the natural world, and also travels back to Leicestershire, the county in which he spent his childhood.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
programme.desc: The naturalist explores how the plants at Kew Gardens change through the seasons and demonstrates the surprising properties of several species, including the predatory pond-dwelling bladderwort utricularia and a fungus that appears to be capable of mind control. programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants

More aesthetically pleasing is a group of beautiful tropical butterflies, followed by an in-depth study into the blow fly - the jet fighter of insects.(n)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Conquest of the Skies
programme.desc: The veteran naturalist visits the jungles of Borneo to meet creatures that like to glide through life - the harlequin tree frog and the little-known colugo - often referred to, incorrectly, as a flying lemur. He also has a CGI-assisted encounter with the first true vertebrate flyer, the pterosaur, receives a flying lesson from a small flock of swans at Loch Lomond in Scotland and encounters the planet's largest species of bat.(n)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Conquest of the Skies
programme.desc: The veteran naturalist turns his attention to creatures that dominate the skies today. He begins with the vast bird family, watching a group of vultures as they go scavenging and some peregrine falcons dive bombing for their prey. He then moves on to the floating forests of Ecuador to find out what makes the humble hummingbird tick, before ending his journey at the Gomantong bat caves of Borneo - a place he first filmed in 1972 - witnessing a mass exodus of the creatures.(n)

programme.desc: When a dangerous storm heads towards Puffin Rock, Oona, Baba and some of their new friends try to bring a missing egg to the safety of the burrows before it is lost - but what is Iseabail up to?(n)

programme.title: Rannan Rapach (Revolting Rhymes)
programme.desc: Part two of two. The Wolf puts a sharp twist into some of the stories children are most fond of by telling them in his own pointed way.(n)

programme.title: A’ Chùil
programme.desc: Choirstaidh shows how to make a soap tart.(n)

programme.title: An Là (News)
programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information.(n)

programme.title: Cèilidh na Bliadhn' Ùire 2025
programme.desc: Cathy MacDonald and Niall Iain Macdonald host from Govan Town Hall, Glasgow, featuring musical guests, Dàimh, with Norrie 'Tago' MacIver, Emma MacLeod and Ruairidh Gray. Following multiple successes at the Lochaber Mod, the Glasgow Gaelic Musical Association, the GGs, showcase their winning harmonies and choral virtuosity under the expert tutelage of Iseabail Mactaggart. Plus, Ingrid Henderson leads the redoubtable Glenfinnan Cèilidh band.(n)

programme.title: Angus Og: The Making of a Tabloid Teuchter
programme.desc: Angus Og was an anti-hero, a boozy, lazy, sneaky Hebridean on the make - but his schemes always failed. Created by Glasgow Gael Ewen Bain, he delighted readers of Scotland's best-selling newspaper for nearly 30 years. This documentary details the story behind the beloved Hebridean cartoon rascal.(New).(n)

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: The tragedy of the naval yacht HMY Iolaire, which sank on January 1, 1919, while bringing hundreds of First World War servicemen home to the Scottish Isles. Short drama, starring Iain MacRae and Douglas Yannaghas.(New).(n)

programme.title: Robert Robertson air Oidhche Challainn
programme.desc: Robert hosts his a New Year party with a fine line-up. He delves into the archive vault for musical highlights from Hogmanay's past featuring Calum Kennedy, Fergie MacDonald and many more. He is joined by some very special guests including Alasdair Gillies, Cathy MacDonald, Mary Anne Kennedy and Joy Dunlop.(n)

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Rianne Downey performs an acoustic session. From her busking days on the streets of Glasgow to performing with Paul Heaton on the Pyramid Stage at Glastonbury, the acclaimed Scottish singer-songwriter has enjoyed a meteoric rise for her music which blends indie, country and pop. Presented by Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald.(New).(n)

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day.(New).

programme.title: My Epic Camel Adventure with Gordon Buchanan
programme.desc: The wildlife cameraman takes a ride through the Gobi desert, starting in the west of Mongolia and crossing blistering sand dunes, endless rocky plains and the treacherous Bumbat Mountain with only his camels for company. To succeed he must befriend the animals, learn as much as he can about them, and try to win their trust and respect, discovering how these creatures have evolved in the most unusual ways to survive and prosper in one of the most hostile environments on the planet.

programme.title: Growing Up Scottish
programme.sub-title: Growing Up Scottish - Festive Special Part Two
programme.desc: Scotland's comedians remember past New Year's Eves, the ups and downs of street parties, the rituals of house parties and attempts at New Year resolutions.

programme.title: Icons of Football
programme.desc: In May 1997, injured Rangers captain Richard Gough looked on from the side-lines at Tannadice as his team took on Dundee United, looking for the win that would secure their ninth league title in a row. Gough had played an integral part in the previous eight titles and getting them to the brink of the nine. But now, at the ground where his career had begun, all he could do was watch. Here, Gough recalls the highs and lows of his career, opens up on his relationships with Jim McLean and Graeme Souness, and reflects on his fall-out with the Scotland management team.

programme.title: Still Game
programme.desc: Craiglang is plunged into darkness after a problem at the power station, calling for radical measures from the pensioners as they protect themselves against undesirables. Anarchy soon spreads, with money going missing and a series of break-ins, but Isa decides to make a stand. Comedy, starring Ford Kiernan, Greg Hemphill and Jane McCarry.

programme.title: The Moments That Made Ford and Greg
programme.desc: The rise of Ford Kiernan and Greg Hemphill, from their first steps on Glasgow's fledgling comedy scene and the memorable characters they created on Chewin' the Fat to the success of Still Game - including its record-breaking live shows.

programme.title: Still Game
programme.desc: Ford Kiernan and Greg Hemphill reunite as Jack and Victor for a stage version of the much-loved sitcom, which recently played in front of thousands of fans at Glasgow's SSE Hydro. Jack is invited to Canada for his daughter's wedding vow renewal, but rather than travel all that way, he decides to embrace technology and be there from the comfort of The Clansman. However, this proves to be more difficult than it should be. Gavin Mitchell and Paul Riley co-star.

programme.title: Still Game: The Story So Far
programme.desc: A tribute to the hit sitcom, focusing on the jaunty journey that Jack and Victor have taken since they first appeared on the small screen. The programme includes interviews with the cast, famous names who have enjoyed cameo performances, and celebrities and superfans, reflecting how the nation has taken the show to its heart. With Ford Kiernan, Greg Hemphill, Lorraine Kelly, Martin Compston and Robbie Coltrane.

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day.(New).

programme.title: Sportscene
programme.desc: Action from the latest matches, featuring Hibernian v Hearts, Livingston v Celtic, Rangers v Motherwell, Dundee v Falkirk, St Mirren v Kilmarnock and Aberdeen v Dundee United.

programme.title: Icons of Football
programme.desc: A profile of former striker Joe Jordan, who earned a reputation as one of football's hard men and played for Leeds United, Manchester United, AC Milan and Scotland. With contributions from Jordan himself, Fabio Capello, Mauro Tassotti, John Giles, Hayley McQueen and Graham Hunter.

programme.title: Away with the Tartan Army - Scotland's Best Moments
programme.desc: Stuart Cosgrove and Tam Cowan explore the highs and lows of following the Scotland football team, and take a trip with the Tartan Army to count down 10 of the best moments. Featuring a trip to Sweden for Scotland's first-ever Euros in 1992, the opening match of the 1998 World Cup in France against the holders Brazil, and an emotional visit to a war-ravaged Bosnia in 1999 on a mission of peace.

programme.title: Only an Excuse
programme.desc: Jonathan Watson leads a hilarious mix of classic sketches, popular characters, famous faces and skits tackling 2020 from a footballing perspective. Featuring nostalgic recollections from guest stars, and material covering Scottish football and the world in general.

programme.title: Scotland's Football Jukebox
programme.desc: A look at the best Scottish football anthems throughout the years, mixing nostalgia, humour and unforgettable tunes, and featuring contributions from the likes of Alan Rough, Murdo MacLeod, Colin Hendry, Fish, Andy Cameron and the Krankies.

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day.(New).

programme.title: Whisky Galore!
programme.desc: In 1943, disaster strikes on the remote Hebridean island of Todday when they run out of whisky. Salvation arrives when a ship carrying 50,000 cases of whisky founders on the island's rocks, but the locals clash with authority in the shape of Home Guard commander Captain Waggett. Comedy, starring James Cosmo, Eddie Izzard and Naomi Battrick.

programme.title: City Lights
programme.desc: Willie's plans for a weekend away from it all take him further than he anticipated. Comedy, starring Gerard Kelly.

programme.title: Still Game
programme.desc: Craiglang is plunged into darkness after a problem at the power station, calling for radical measures from the pensioners as they protect themselves against undesirables. Anarchy soon spreads, with money going missing and a series of break-ins, but Isa decides to make a stand. Comedy, starring Ford Kiernan, Greg Hemphill and Jane McCarry.

programme.title: Breaking the News
programme.desc: Des Clarke hosts the topical comedy news quiz in which four panellists take a satirical swipe at the week's news agenda in Scotland and across the UK.

programme.title: Scot Squad
programme.desc: A New Year episode of the spoof documentary about a fictional Scottish police force, made in a fly-on-the-wall style. The sirens are blaring and the bells are ringing as officers work a New Year's shift. Their duties include everything from checking ceilidhs to making sure steak pies are legal. Even Chief Miekelson is working hard, urging all of Scotland to party responsibly on the biggest blowout night of the year. Singer Eddi Reader meakes a guest appearance.

programme.title: The Moments That Made..
programme.desc: Celebrating the life and career of the comedy actor, featuring an interview with the Scot Squad star and other key people from his career.

programme.title: Janey Godley: Still Got It
programme.desc: Stand-up performance recorded at Glasgow's Websters Theatre in 2022, in which the comedian reflects on undergoing cancer treatment and pondering how her time in recovery and isolation had given her a new perspective on life. Janey died in November 2024, but continued to direct her formidable wit towards the illness until the end.

programme.title: Interior Design Masters with Alan Carr
programme.desc: The two finalists go head to head, each taking on the redesign of a trendy bar in London's vibrant Soho district. They have three days to make over the ground-floor bar and an intimate basement cocktail lounge - and to help, both contestants have a fellow team-mate, plus a team of trades. One designer goes all-out, relocating the bar to the other side of the room - but the more they rip out, the more it becomes a demolition zone. Down the road, there is indecision and angst as the other finalist realises just how much is at stake. Who will win the career-defining contract to design an upmarket apartment on the Cornish coast?

programme.title: Island Crossings
programme.desc: Documentary following staff of ferry operators Caledonian MacBrayne, their passengers and the residents of the islands they serve. Ardrossan staff deal with delays and queues due to an engine fault as the Kilbarchan Pipe Band are among competitors and spectators trying to attend the annual Brodick Highland Games. In Mull, 12-year-old Oscar heads to the mainland where he'll spend weekdays away from home for the first time at secondary school.

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day.(New).

programme.title: Paramedics on Scene
programme.desc: An elderly woman has a nasty fall while walking her dog on a hillside, but luckily passers-by call for an ambulance and the Special Operations team arrive in a four-wheel drive vehicle, Meanwhile, those responsible for dispatching ambulances from a Glasgow call centre struggle to locate a patient who they have been advised needs urgent mental-health support.

programme.title: The Great Food Guys
programme.desc: Nick Nairn and Dougie Vipond return to their Aberdeenshire country kitchen for the second of two festive specials, making a hearty venison pie with seasonal vegetables. Joining them is international wrestler and TV actor Graeme Stevely - better known as Grado - to chat, taste and raise a glass.

programme.title: Growing Up Scottish
programme.sub-title: Growing Up Scottish - Festive Special Part Two
programme.desc: Scotland's comedians remember past New Year's Eves, the ups and downs of street parties, the rituals of house parties and attempts at New Year resolutions.

programme.title: Rikki
programme.desc: Ashley Jensen narrates a programme celebrating the life, career and legacy of Rikki Fulton, one of Scotland's most beloved comic actors and undisputed King of Hogmanay. This film tells the story of his extraordinary life by bringing together the people closest to him and the people he inspired, with never-before-seen home movie footage and clips of the best-loved moments of his career.

programme.title: Scotch & Wry
programme.desc: Hogmanay comedy from Rikki Fulton and his team of Gregor Fisher, Juliet Cadzow, Tony Roper and Annette Staines, with music from Barbara Dickson. From 1986.

programme.title: Still Game
programme.desc: Festive episode of the popular Scottish comedy, in which Jack and Victor face the prospect of a gloomy Hogmanay stuck in the lift at Osprey Heights, and console themselves by recalling New Years past. As the clock ticks down to 2007, Winston is also in a reminiscent mood, and takes refuge in memories of a legendary holiday season when Craigland really knew how to throw a party. Ford Kiernan, Greg Hemphill and Paul Riley star.

programme.title: Scot Squad
programme.desc: A New Year episode of the spoof documentary about a fictional Scottish police force, made in a fly-on-the-wall style. programme.title: Tales from the Pub
programme.desc: Raymond plots revenge on a neighbour who refuses to pick up her dog's poo in the park, Comedy horror written and directed by Kris J Cummins and David O Gray.(New).

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day.(New).

programme.title: Reindeer Family & Me
programme.desc: Gordon Buchanan travels to Finnish Lapland to meet a family from the nomadic Sami culture, who rely on reindeer to help them travel across the frozen wilderness. He learns about the culture's traditional bond with the animals and picks up some tips on surviving during a harsh winter, before he and his reindeer companion undertake a gruelling journey to see the northern lights.

programme.title: World Pipe Band Championships
programme.desc: Jackie Bird presents highlights of the competition held on Glasgow Green, with expert Bob Worrall on hand to provide commentary on the most important event in the piping calendar.

programme.title: Short Stuff
programme.desc: Compilation featuring some of the highlights from 2025's content, along with sketches from Nikola McMurtrie, Them Is Brothers, Charlie Vero Martin and Kate Hammer.

programme.title: Still Game
programme.desc: Jack and Victor race Winston and Tam to a Highland retreat for Hogmanay, while Navid finds himself at a loose end when Meena visits her sister in India. Comedy, starring Ford Kiernan and Greg Hemphill, who don the personae of the characters from comedy series Chewin' the Fat.

programme.title: Two Doors Down
programme.desc: When Eric and Beth put their tree up earlier than usual, they unwittingly kick off the Christmas season in Latimer Crescent. What starts as a labour-saving convenience quickly turns into a flurry of festive activity as their son Ian and partner Gordon, neighbours Colin, Cathy, Christine, Michelle and Alan start to gear up for the holidays in their own unique ways. Festive edition of the comedy, starring Arabella Weir, Alex Norton, Elaine C Smith, Doon Mackichan and Jonathan Watson.

programme.title: Mark Nelson: Live from Dumfries
programme.desc: The comedian performs in his home town's Theatre Royal, with routines about growing up in the south-west of Scotland in the 1990s, bringing his wife back to the city to revisit the nightclubs of his youth, and becoming a family man on the road to middle age.

programme.title: Breaking the News
programme.desc: Des Clarke hosts the topical comedy news quiz in which four panellists take a satirical swipe at the week's news agenda in Scotland and across the UK.

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day.(New).

programme.title: The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo
programme.sub-title: The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo: 75th Anniversary
programme.desc: Highlights of the 75th anniversary event held on the esplanade of Edinburgh Castle. The Massed Pipes and Drums and Tattoo Fiddlers and Highland Dancers provide a showcase of Scottish culture against a backdrop of imagery that captures 75 years of the tattoo and includes a celebration of Edinburgh's 900th anniversary. Commentary is provided by JJ Chalmers and Jennifer Reoch.

programme.title: Sportscene
programme.sub-title: Sportscene: Road to the World Cup
programme.desc: A look back at Scotland's historic World Cup qualifying campaign as Steve Clarke's side booked their place at next summer's showpiece.(New).

programme.title: Not Quite End of Year Show
programme.desc: The countdown to the Bells begins as Des Clarke looks back at 2025 with Scottish stars of screen and sport. There is music from singer Michelle McManus and Robert Robertson of Tide Lines with house band Roddy Hart & the Lonesome Fire, as well as a rousing set from Gaelic folk band Mànran.(New).

programme.title: Scotland Stands Up
programme.desc: Stuart Mitchell hosts a night of comedy at the Church Hill Theatre in Edinburgh. Scotland-based American Krystal Evans finds the funny in the differences and similarities in world views and family values, while rising star Ayo Adenekan wrestles with his identity and reveals his ambitions to become a truly unique Scottish superhero. Jay Lafferty vividly describes the challenges she faces as she gets older, while the headliner is Burnistoun's Robert Florence, making a rare stand-up appearance.(New).

programme.title: First Footing
programme.desc: Paul wakes up from a wild New Year's Eve, with little memory of the night before spent at his mum's social club. When it's revealed that the prize money from the annual New Year's Eve karaoke competition has gone missing, Paul fears his good name and reputation are at stake. Comedy, written by and starring Paul Black.

programme.title: How Auld Lang Syne Took Over the World
programme.desc: Dougie Vipond examines how Robert Burns' 18th-century poem, traditionally sung around the world on New Year's Eve, became one of Scotland's best-known musical exports. From Ayrshire to Tokyo, via New York City, he finds out how Auld Lang Syne has been adopted by different cultures, with commentary from well-known faces including Alan Cumming, Cliff Richard and Clare Grogan.

programme.title: Hogmanay Live
programme.desc: Amy Irons leads the nation into the New Year, with music from Nathan Evans, Michelle McManus, Robert Robertson, Georgia Cécile, Roddy Hart & the Lonesome Fire and Mànran, while some of Scotland's biggest TV stars join Amy on the sofa to look back at their highlights of 2025. Des Clarke leads the countdown to the Bells from Edinburgh, with 2026 being welcomed by the traditional lone piper on the ramparts of the castle, the firing of Mons Meg to mark midnight and a fireworks display above the capital, soundtracked by the BBC Scottish Symphony Orchestra.(New).(n)

programme.title: My Kind of Town
programme.desc: Ian Hamilton and his guide dog Major visit Alloa, which sits on the River Forth and was famous for brewing and glassmaking. He takes on a judo champion, visits a successful business on the high street, and hears about some dramatic paranormal events in the area. He and the crew also get the opportunity to try some handmade tablet, and Ian grabs the chance to take part in a tasting at Alloa's last brewery.(n)

programme.title: Loch Ness
programme.desc: A cynical American scientist is sent to Scotland to prove the Loch Ness monster does not exist, to the outrage of the locals. However, an innkeeper's nine-year-old daughter makes him wonder if there may be some truth to the legend. Family drama, starring Ted Danson, Joely Richardson, Ian Holm, James Frain, Kirsty Graham and Harris Yulin.(n)

programme.title: Being Stanley Baxter
programme.desc: A profile of the Glasgow-born actor, comedian and impressionist, who died at the age of 99 on December 11, charting his extraordinary professional journey and personal life by drawing on rare archive footage and candid interviews. The film reflects the complex aspects of his long and distinguished life as well as celebrating his comedic genius, particularly his impressionist and satirical work.(New).(n)

programme.title: The Stanley Baxter Show
programme.desc: Another chance to see a collection of comedy sketches from the veteran comedian and impressionist. First broadcast in 1998.(n)

programme.title: Queen of the New Year
programme.desc: Sketch show looking back at the global and national news of the year with a Scottish twist. Featuring Stephen Buchanan, Louise McCarthy, Paul McCole, Katie Barnett, Chris Toal, Barbara Rafferty, Lisa Livingstone, Neil Bratchpiece, Katia Kvinge, Ayo Adenekan, Michael Dylan and Betty Valencia.(New).(n)

programme.title: Tinsel Town
programme.desc: Washed-up Hollywood action hero Bradley Mack takes a role in a small English village's quirky Christmas pantomime, where he finds unexpected inspiration through the show's straight-talking dance instructor. Festive family comedy, starring Kiefer Sutherland, Rebel Wilson, Alice Eve and Danny Dyer.

programme.title: The Best Christmas Pageant Ever
programme.desc: Nobody is ready for the mayhem that ensues when six of the worst youngsters disrupt the town's annual Christmas performance. Festive comedy based on the Barbara Robinson novel, starring Lauren Graham, Judy Greer and Pete Holmes.

programme.title: She's Making a List
programme.desc: A Christmas inspector whose job it is to decide whether children have been naughty or nice fall for the widowed father of the girl she's supposed to evaluate. Before she knows it, her job - and her heart - are on the line. Romantic comedy, starring Lacey Chabert and Alessandro Miro.

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: When a solitary writer adopts and bonds with a Great Dane that belonged to a late friend, she begins to come to terms with her past and her own creative inner life. Drama based on the novel by Sigrid Nunez, starring Naomi Watts and Bill Murray.

programme.title: A Minecraft Movie
programme.desc: Four misfits are yanked through a strange portal into a cubic realm powered by imagination. To return home, they must learn its rules and journey alongside an unlikely master crafter. Director Jared Hess's blockbusting fantasy adventure based on the hit videogame, starring Jack Black, Jason Momoa, Emma Myers and Jennifer Coolidge.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Kung fu prodigy Li Fong moves to New York City with his mother and befriends his classmate, Mia. But Connor Day, a local karate champion, provokes Li and publicly humiliates him. Li seeks guidance from his mentor, the kung fu master Mr Han, who reaches out to Daniel LaRusso, convincing the original Karate Kid to teach Li the principles of Miyagi Karate. Drama sequel, starring Jackie Chan, Ben Wang and Ralph Macchio.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Hoping to escape their troubled pasts, twin brothers return to their hometown to start over, only to find an even darker force waiting to welcome them back. Writer/director Ryan Coogler's blockbusting horror thriller, starring Michael B Jordan, Miles Caton and Saul Williams.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: IMF agent Ethan Hunt is in exile with both halves of the 3D cruciform key that can unlock the source code of rogue AI creation, the Entity. Hunt returns to London to reunite with Luther Stickell, Benji Dunn and former thief Grace. The Entity's human henchman, Gabriel, is still on the loose, so Hunt bolsters his ranks with vengeful French assassin Paris and US intelligence agent Theo Degas. Action thriller, starring Tom Cruise, Hayley Atwell, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg and Esai Morales.
